description.en: Increases ##Shadow Clone#4002#'s &Param3&. Reduces the intervals between their sprint attacks.

description.en: When a ##Shadow Clone#4002# deals DMG, increases all ##Shadow Clones#4002#' &Param3& on the battlefield.

description.zh: 提升##暗影分身#4002#的伤害。
description.en: Increases ##Shadow Clone#4002#'s DMG.

description.zh: 翡冷翠提升&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Firenze's &Param2&.

description.zh: ##暗影分身#4002#消失时产生自爆造成范围伤害。
description.en: Upon vanishing, Firenze's ##Shadow Clones#4002# will explode, dealing AoE DMG.

description.zh: 提升全队暗系角色&Param2&。
description.en: Increases all Umbra Trekkers' &Param2&.

description.zh: 鸢尾普攻命中目标时，提升下次主控技的伤害。叠加至上限后，强化下次主控技。
description.en: When Iris hits a target with an Auto Attack, increases the DMG of the next Main Skill. Once fully stacked, enhances the next Main Skill.

description.zh: 主控技命中目标时额外造成范围伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill hits a target, deals additional AoE DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技有概率激活「霜华」：持续攻击目标。
description.en: Casting the Main Skill has a chance to activate Frostflare, dealing damage over time.

description.zh: 主控技触发印记时，标记目标，持续造成额外伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill triggers a Mark, marks the target and deals additional DMG over time.

description.zh: 提升「霜箭」的伤害，并使其可穿透目标。
description.en: Increases Frost Arrows' DMG, allowing them to pierce through targets.

description.zh: 提升「霜箭」的伤害和数量。
description.en: Fires more Frost Arrows and increases their DMG.

description.zh: 每隔一段时间提升鸢尾下次主控技的伤害。
description.en: Every few seconds, increases the DMG of Iris's next Main Skill.

description.zh: 鸢尾主控技持续期间提升攻击力并霸体。
description.en: While Iris's Main Skill is active, increases her ATK and grants Super Armor.

description.zh: 将目标附带的##寒冷#1027#转化为##冰冻#1002#时，提升&Param5&，缩短主控技冷却。
description.en: When Iris changes a target's status from ##Chill#1027# to ##Frozen#1002#, increases &Param5& and reduces Main Skill Cooldown.

description.zh: 鸢尾受到近战攻击时，对附近目标造成伤害并附加##冰冻#1002#。
description.en: When Iris is hit by a melee strike, deals DMG and inflicts ##Frozen#1002# on nearby targets.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##水流印记#2022#，并附加##寒冷#1027#。触发时提升攻击力。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2022# and inflict ##Chill#1027#. Triggering this effect will increase Iris' ATK.

description.zh: 鸢尾主控技暴击时，造成额外伤害。
description.en: When Iris's Main Skill lands a Crit Hit, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 鸢尾提升挥舞书包的伤害，有概率击晕目标。
description.en: When Iris attacks with her school bag, increases DMG, with a chance to stun the target.

description.zh: 绝招持续期间，每秒对范围内的随机目标造成额外伤害。
description.en: While the Ultimate is active, deals additional DMG per second to random targets within range.

description.zh: 绝招持续期间，每有目标被消灭，提升&Param2&。
description.en: While the Ultimate is active, each time a target is killed, increases &Param2&.

description.zh: 鸢尾绝招伤害范围内，提升自身和友方角色的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Iris's &Param2& and that of her squadmates if they are within her Ultimate's Attack Range.

description.zh: 提升「冰柱阵列」的伤害范围和造成的伤害。
description.en: Increases Glacier Array's Attack Range and DMG.

description.zh: 「冰柱阵列」可牵引目标，提升其造成的伤害。
description.en: Glacier Array can pull in targets, increasing its DMG.

description.zh: 「冰柱阵列」生成时造成额外伤害并眩晕目标。
description.en: When Glacier Array is created, deals additional DMG and stuns the target.

description.zh: 「冰柱阵列」结束时造成额外伤害并击飞目标。
description.en: When Glacier Array vanishes, deals additional DMG and sends the targets back flying.

description.zh: 提升「冰柱阵列」造成的伤害，并缩短伤害间隔。
description.en: Increases Glacier Array's DMG and reduces its Attack Interval.

description.zh: 提升「冰柱阵列」的持续时间和造成的伤害。
description.en: Increases the duration and DMG of Glacier Array.

description.zh: 援护技命中附带##寒冷#1027#的目标时，提升主控角色&Param4&。
description.en: When the Support Skill hits a target with ##Chill#1027#, increases the main Trekker's &Param4&.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，如果范围存在少量目标，使其受到水系伤害提升。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, if there are few targets within the impact range, increases the Aqua DMG taken by the targets.

description.zh: 援护技持续期间，提升伤害范围内友方的攻击力。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, increases the ATK of all other friendly units within its Attack Range.

description.zh: 提升鸢尾技能伤害。
description.en: Increases Iris' Skill DMG.

description.zh: 提升绝招伤害，可附加##水流印记#2008#。
description.en: Increases Ultimate DMG and inflicts ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 援护技持续期间，伤害范围内每有目标被消灭时，造成额外范围伤害，并##冰冻#1002#目标。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, each time a target within its Attack Range is killed, deals additional AoE DMG and inflicts ##Frozen#1002# to nearby targets.

description.zh: 首次施放援护技时，提升全队的&Param4&。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill for the first time, increases the squad's &Param4&.

description.zh: 增加二段主控技「升龙斩」。
description.en: Adds Dragon Slash as the second phase of the Main Skill.

description.zh: 提升尘沙&Param3&。施放主控技后自动施放「回旋斩」。
description.en: Increases Noya's &Param3&. After casting the Main Skill, automatically casts Devastating Wind.

description.zh: 尘沙普攻造成伤害时，有概率产生##多重剑气#1054#。
description.en: When Noya deals DMG with an Auto Attack, there is a chance to cast ##Multi Sword Aura#1054#.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，普攻变为剑气攻击，持续一段时间。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, Auto Attacks become sword aura Attacks for a period of time.

description.zh: 尘沙施放普攻最后一段和「回旋斩」额外施放剑气。
description.en: Noya will unleash extra sword auras during the final strike of Auto Attack and Devastating Wind.

description.zh: 技能额外施放剑气。
description.en: Skills can unleash extra sword auras.

description.zh: 主控技命中目标时提升&Param2&。
description.en: When the Main Skill hits a target, increases &Param2&.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，普攻时提升攻速。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, increases the speed of Auto Attacks.

description.zh: 尘沙普攻造成伤害时，提升绝招伤害。
description.en: When Noya deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 尘沙造成伤害时，削减目标韧性。
description.en: When Noya deals DMG, reduces the target's Resilience.

description.zh: 尘沙的闪避可穿越地形，提升对中远距离目标的&Param2&。
description.en: Noya can dodge through barriers. Increases her &Param2& to distant targets.

description.zh: 尘沙对同一目标造成伤害时，提升对其造成的&Param4&。
description.en: When Noya deals DMG to the same target, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升尘沙闪避次数和对近距离目标的&Param2&。
description.en: Noya can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param2& to nearby targets.

description.zh: 绝招消灭目标时，获得能量。
description.en: When the Ultimate kills a target, gains Energy.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，全队提升&Param3&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's &Param3&.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，提升尘沙&Param1&。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Noya's &Param1&.

description.zh: 大剑气发射次数增加。
description.en: Unleashes more major sword auras.

description.zh: 大剑气变为十字大剑气。
description.en: Major sword auras become cross major sword auras.

description.zh: 小剑气首次造成伤害时发生分裂。
description.en: When the minor sword aura deals DMG for the first time, it splits into even smaller sword auras.

description.zh: 小剑气施放次数增加。
description.en: Can cast additional minor sword auras.

description.zh: 提升大剑气对附带##风系印记：风息#2017#的目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases the major sword auras' &Param2& to the targets with ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#.

description.zh: 提升大剑气攻击范围和造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases major sword auras' Attack Range and &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升大剑气造成的&Param2&，并降低目标移速。
description.en: Increases major sword auras' &Param2&. Also reduces the target's Movement SPD.

description.zh: 小剑气可触发##风系印记：风息#2017#，提升造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases minor sword auras' &Param2&. They can also trigger ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#.

description.zh: 尘沙提升&Param3&。援护技消灭目标时，缩短冷却。
description.en: Increases Noya's &Param3&. When killing a target with the Support Skill, reduces its Cooldown.

description.zh: 尘沙触发##风系印记：风息#2017#时，提升尘沙&Param1&。
description.en: When Noya triggers ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 援护技对精英及以上目标提升造成的&Param2&。
description.en: The Support Skill deals higher &Param2& to elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&，加快小剑气施放。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param2&. Casts minor sword auras faster.

description.zh: 尘沙触发##风系印记：风息#2017#时，随机援护角色获得能量。
description.en: When Noya triggers ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#, restores Energy for a random support Trekker.

description.zh: 「一式」攻击次数提升，且对精英及以上目标造成伤害时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: Launches more attacks in Phase 1. When dealing DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 技能变为发射水刃，对精英及以上目标造成的&Param4&提升。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, Shimiao unleashes water blades instead, dealing increased &Param4& to elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 提升主控技伤害范围。提升「二式」的&Param5&。「一式」对不同目标造成伤害时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Main Skill's Attack Range. Increases &Param5& of Phase 2. When hitting different targets in Phase 1, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 技能期间，根据旋转圈数生成水波纹，造成伤害，可触发##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, creates water ripples based on the number of spins. The water ripples deal DMG and can trigger ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 「一式」持续期间获得霸体，受到攻击时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: While in Phase 1, Shimiao gains Super Armor. When attacked, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 激活「二式」后不施放，缩短技能冷却时间，提升下次「一式」的&Param3&。
description.en: If Phase 2 is activated but not cast, reduces Skill Cooldown and increases the next Phase 1's &Param3&.

description.zh: 「二式」对##寒冷#1027#或##冰冻#1002#目标造成的&Param10&提升，目标生命越低伤害越高。
description.en: Phase 2 deals more &Param10& to targets with ##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002#. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG.

description.zh: 师渺造成伤害时，生成水波纹，可触发##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: When Shimiao deals DMG, she creates water ripples that can trigger ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 师渺施放技能或闪避时，生成多个小水坑。
description.en: When casting a skill or dodging, Shimiao creates small water puddles.

description.zh: 施放「二式」后，强化普攻。
description.en: After casting Phase 2, enhances the Auto Attack.

description.zh: 师渺普攻对附带##寒冷#1027#或##冰冻#1002#目标造成伤害时，提升&Param5&和&Param6&。
description.en: When Shimiao deals DMG to targets inflicted with ##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002# with an Auto Attack, increases her &Param5& and &Param6&.

description.zh: 「二式」消灭##冰冻#1002#目标时，可再次施放，同时提升&Param1&。
description.en: When Shimiao casts Rising Tides Phase 2 and kills a target with ##Frozen#1002#, the Skill can be cast again immediately. Also increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 主控技对附带##寒冷#1027#的目标，造成额外效果。
description.en: The Main Skill applies a bonus effect to targets with ##Chill#1027#.

description.zh: 提升绝招横扫的伤害范围。提升对附带##水系印记：水流#2008#、##寒冷#1027#或##冰冻#1002#目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases the sweeping strike's Attack Range. Also increases Shimiao's &Param2& to targets with ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#/##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002#.

description.zh: 绝招对##寒冷#1027#或##冰冻#1002#目标造成的&Param10&提升，目标生命越低伤害越高。
description.en: The Ultimate deals more &Param10& to targets with ##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002#. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG.

description.zh: 绝招「御水诀」生成多个小水坑，造成伤害。
description.en: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), Shimiao creates small water puddles, dealing DMG.

description.zh: 提升援护技的水剑数量和&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the number and &Param1& of the Support Skill's water blades.

description.zh: 援护技发射水剑时，有概率额外发射水弹丸，造成伤害，同时提升&Param5&。
description.en: The Support Skill has a chance to fire additional water pellets when shooting water blades, dealing DMG. Also increases Shimiao's &Param5&.

description.zh: 援护技中水剑的&Param1&提升。援护技「仗剑登瀑」发射大型水剑伤害，可穿透目标。
description.en: Increases &Param1& of the Support Skill's water blades.Aqua Aide (Support Skill) deals DMG with a major water blade that can pierce through targets.

description.zh: 援护技持续期间，可跟随主控角色战斗，周期性提升水剑造成的&Param1&。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, Shimiao follows the Main Trekker and launches attacks, increasing her water blades' &Param1& periodically.

description.zh: 援护技对精英及以上目标造成伤害时，提升师渺&Param4&。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases Shimiao's &Param4&.

description.zh: 援护技「仗剑登瀑」可附加减速，造成的&Param4&提升。
description.en: Aqua Aide (Support Skill) can slow targets and its &Param4& is increased.

description.zh: 援护技造成伤害时，提升师渺&Param4&。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases Shimiao's &Param4&.

description.zh: 不移动时，逐渐提升师渺&Param4&。
description.en: When Shimiao remains stationary, increases her &Param4& over time.

description.zh: 师渺消灭目标时，生成水波纹，可触发##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: When Shimiao kills a target, she creates water ripples that can trigger ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 援护技对附带##寒冷#1027#的目标，造成额外效果。
description.en: The Support Skill applies a bonus effect to targets with ##Chill#1027#.

description.zh: 师渺消灭附带##水系印记：水流#2008#、##寒冷#1027#或##冰冻#1002#目标时，获得能量。
description.en: When Shimiao kills a target with ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#/##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002#, she gains Energy.

description.zh: 师渺在场时，生成水波纹，可触发##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: When Shimiao is on the battlefield, she creates water ripples that can trigger ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 师渺入场时，提升全队&Param3&。
description.en: When Shimiao enters combat, increases the squad's &Param3&.

description.zh: 「弹球炸弹」每次落地时，额外造成范围伤害。提升「弹球炸弹」造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Each time a Bouncing Bomb lands, it deals additional AoE DMG.Increases the &Param2& dealt by the Bouncing Bomb.

description.zh: 长按主控技时，猫眼投掷更多「弹球炸弹」。提升「弹球炸弹」造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When holding the Main Skill button, Chaton throws more Bouncing Bombs.Increases the &Param2& dealt by the Bouncing Bomb.

description.zh: 「暗黑标记」的伤害间隔缩短。提升猫眼对附带「暗黑标记」的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Reduces Dark Mark's Attack Interval.Increases Chaton's &Param1& to targets inflicted with Dark Mark.

description.zh: 提升##黑暗射线#4036#造成的&Param2&。激光命中附带「暗黑标记」的目标时，提升「暗黑标记」的伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& dealt by ##Dark Ray#4036#.Increases Dark Mark's DMG when the laser hits a target inflicted with Dark Mark.

description.zh: 提升「弹球炸弹」的弹射次数。提升「弹球炸弹」造成伤害时的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases a Bouncing Bomb's bounce count.Increases the &Param1& when a Bouncing Bomb deals DMG.

description.zh: 「弹球炸弹」的弹射次数用尽后会返回猫眼身边，使猫眼获得「火苗」。长按主控技时，消耗「火苗」提升猫眼&Param2&，并对目标造成额外伤害。
description.en: When a Bouncing Bomb runs out of bounces, it returns to Chaton and grants her Spark.When holding the Main Skill button, consumes Spark to increase Chaton's &Param2& and deals additional DMG to the target.

description.zh: 提升「弹球炸弹」的&Param1&。「弹球炸弹」造成暴击时，提升目标受到「弹球炸弹」造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Bouncing Bomb's &Param1&.When a Bouncing Bomb lands a Crit Hit, increases the &Param3& the target takes from it.

description.zh: 提升##黑暗射线#4036#的&Param1&。当激光造成暴击时，重置主控技冷却并提升##黑暗射线#4036#造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of ##Dark Ray#4036#.When the laser lands a Crit Hit, resets the Main Skill's Cooldown and increases the &Param3& dealt by ##Dark Ray#4036#.

description.zh: 当「暗黑标记」造成暴击后，提升「暗黑标记」造成伤害时的&Param1&。
description.en: After Dark Mark lands a Crit Hit, increases the &Param1& of Dark Mark when it deals DMG.

description.zh: 提升猫眼闪避次数。猫眼施放主控技时，提升自身&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Chaton's dodges.When Chaton casts the Main Skill, increases her &Param2&.

description.zh: 激活猫眼普攻的连射模式，提升攻击频率。猫眼触发印记时，提升自身&Param2&。
description.en: Activates the rapid-fire mode for Chaton's Auto Attack, increasing her attack frequency.When Chaton triggers a mark, increases her &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升##黑暗射线#4036#造成的&Param1&。猫眼的普攻对附带「暗黑标记」的目标造成伤害时，额外造成伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by ##Dark Ray#4036#.Chaton's Auto Attacks deal additional DMG to targets inflicted with Dark Mark.

description.zh: 提升猫眼对当前生命较高的目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Chaton's &Param2& dealt to targets with higher HP.

description.zh: 绝招与「黑暗爆发」对附带「喵眼标记」的目标造成伤害时，额外造成伤害。
description.en: The Ultimate and Dark Burst deal additional DMG to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.

description.zh: 提升##魔眼解放#4035#状态的持续时间。提升猫眼的&Param1&。使「黑暗爆发」射出的子弹可穿透目标。
description.en: Increases the duration of ##Evil Eye Unleashed#4035#.Increases Chaton's &Param1&.Allows bullets fired by Dark Burst to penetrate targets.

description.zh: 「喵眼标记」在绝招结束后会继续残留在目标身上，提升猫眼对附带「喵眼标记」的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Cat Eye Mark remains on the target after the Ultimate ends. Increases Chaton's &Param1& to targets inflicted with Cat Eye Mark.

description.zh: 援护技每次射击命中首个目标时额外造成伤害。
description.en: When each shot of the Support Skill hits its first target, deals additional DMG.

name.en: Strike While the Iron is Hot

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&。当「贯穿弹」暴击时，本次援护技额外射击1次。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the Support Skill.When Penetrating Bullet lands a Crit Hit, the Support Skill fires 1 additional shot.

description.zh: 援护技「&Param1&」造成的&Param2&。援护技每次射击时，发射更多「贯穿弹」。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& dealt by &Param1& (Support Skill).Each time the Support Skill fires, shoots more Penetrating Bullets.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&。当「贯穿弹」造成时，分裂为大量「小型贯穿弹」造成伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the Support Skill.When Penetrating Bullet deals DMG, it splits into many Small Penetrating Bullets that also deal DMG.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&。施放援护技时，魔眼锁定目标当前位置，持续造成范围伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the Support Skill.When casting the Support Skill, Evil Eye locks onto the target's current position, dealing AoE DMG over time.

description.zh: 提升猫眼对附带「锁定」的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& Chaton deals to targets inflicted with Lock.

description.zh: 援护技期间，猫眼对当前目标造成的&Param2&随时间提升。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, increases the &Param2& dealt by Chaton to the current target over time.

description.zh: 提升猫眼的&Param2&。援护技每次射击时，额外发射「猫猫炸弹」，造成伤害。
description.en: Increases Chaton's &Param2&.Each time the Support Skill fires, shoots additional Meow Bombs, dealing DMG.

description.zh: 援护技直接消灭当前生命较低的普通目标。提升对当前生命较低的精英或首领目标造成的&Param3&。
description.en: The Support Skill instantly eliminates normal targets with low HP.Increases the &Param3& dealt to elite or boss targets with low HP.

description.zh: 当猫眼的能量充满时，提升猫眼的&Param1&。
description.en: When Chaton's Energy is full, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 援护技「&Param1&」期间，提升猫眼的&Param2&。
description.en: While &Param1& (Support Skill) is active, increases Chaton's &Param2&.

description.zh: 援护技每次造成暴击时，提升本次援护技造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When the Support Skill lands a Crit Hit, increases the &Param2& it deals.

description.zh: 提升队伍中火系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Ignis Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」同时攻击目标，造成伤害，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: Avalanche: Floating Cannons attack the target simultaneously, dealing DMG. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」持续对相同目标造成多次伤害后，提升自身&Param3&。
description.en: After Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal multiple instances of DMG to the same target, increases own &Param3&.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」造成伤害时，生成「烈日照射」，持续攻击目标位置，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: When dealing DMG, Avalanche: Floating Cannons generate Scorching Sunray that continuously attacks the target's position. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」发出的射线会折射，同时对多个目标造成伤害，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: The beams fired by Avalanche: Floating Cannons can refract, simultaneously dealing DMG to multiple targets. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」对首领或精英目标造成伤害时，提升全队&Param5&。
description.en: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal DMG to the boss or elite targets, increases the squad's &Param5&.

description.zh: 火垂在##炮击形态#4030#期间，每间隔一段时间「雪崩·浮游炮」向目标齐射，造成额外伤害，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: While Firefly is in ##Artillery Form#4030#, Avalanche: Floating Cannons periodically fire a volley at the target, dealing bonus DMG. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 提升火垂对孤立的目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Firefly's &Param2& dealt to lone targets.

description.zh: 施放主控技时发射能量弹，造成范围伤害，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, Firefly shoots an energy round, dealing AoE DMG. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 每间隔一段时间，提升「雪崩·浮游炮」造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases &Param3& dealt by Avalanche: Floating Cannons at set intervals.

description.zh: 提升火垂&Param2&。火垂每次触发##光系印记#1015#时，提升自身&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Firefly's &Param2&.Every time Firefly triggers ##Lux Mark#1015#, increases own &Param3&.

description.zh: 增加火垂闪避次数。闪避后，对附近的目标造成光系伤害并眩晕，可触发##光系印记#1015#。
description.en: Increases the number of times Firefly can dodge.After dodging, Firefly deals Lux DMG to nearby targets and stuns them. Can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#.

description.zh: 「雪崩·浮游炮」命中不同的附带##光系印记#1015#的目标时，提升全队&Param4&。
description.en: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons hit different targets afflicted with ##Lux Marks#1015#, increases the squad's &Param4&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##光系印记#1015#，触发时提升自身&Param6&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015#. When the mark is triggered, increases own &Param6&.

description.zh: 火垂施放绝招后，下次施放技能时提升自身&Param3&。
description.en: After Firefly casts the Ultimate, increases her &Param3& the next time she casts a skill.

description.zh: 提升火垂绝招造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the &Param3& dealt by Firefly's Ultimate.

description.zh: 提升火垂绝招对低生命的目标，造成的&Param4&。
description.en: Increases the &Param4& dealt by Firefly's Ultimate to targets with low HP.

description.zh: 当全队均为光系角色时，施放援护技额外获得更多「雪崩·飞刃」。每当「雪崩·飞刃」造成伤害时，提升自身造成的&Param2&和&Param4&。
description.en: In an all-Lux squad, casting the Support Skill grants additional Avalanche: Flying Blades.Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, increases own &Param2& and &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升「雪崩·飞刃」造成伤害时的&Param1&。每当「雪崩·飞刃」造成伤害时，额外造成范围伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Avalanche: Flying Blade when it deals DMG.Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it deals additional AoE DMG and inflicts ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.

description.zh: 当全队均为光系角色时，提升「雪崩·巨剑」的攻击范围与造成的&Param2&。每当「雪崩·巨剑」攻击时，追加额外攻击，造成伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。
description.en: In an all-Lux squad, increases the attack range and &Param2& of Avalanche: Giant Sword.Whenever Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks, it triggers an additional attack, dealing DMG and inflicting ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.

description.zh: 「雪崩·巨剑」攻击一定次数后，火垂自动施放「霸斩」，造成伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。
description.en: After Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks a certain number of times, Firefly automatically casts Dominating Slash, dealing DMG and inflicting ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.

description.zh: 光系主控角色触发##光系印记#1015#，以及产生##光耀#4028#后，火垂下一次##剑击形态#4031#期间，提升「雪崩·飞刃」造成的&Param3&和&Param6&。
description.en: After the Lux Main Trekker triggers ##Lux Mark#1015# and generates ##Lucent#4028#, increases the &Param3& and &Param6& of Avalanche: Flying Blade the next time Firefly is in ##Sword Form#4031#.

description.zh: 光系主控角色造成技能伤害时，产生「雪崩·飞刃」打击目标造成额外伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。该「雪崩·飞刃」在造成伤害时，根据目标附带的##光幕#4029#层数，提升目标&Param3&。
description.en: When the Lux Main Trekker deals Skill DMG, generates Avalanche: Flying Blade to strike the target, dealing additional DMG and inflicting ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.When this Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it increases the target's &Param3& based on the number of ##Light Curtain#4029# stacks on the target.

description.zh: 火垂在##剑击形态#4031#结束时，操纵所有的##雪崩#4032#打击自身周围目标造成范围伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。该效果每次造成伤害时，提升火垂的&Param2&。
description.en: When ##Sword Form#4031# ends, Firefly commands all ##Avalanches#4032# to strike targets around her, dealing AoE DMG and inflicting ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.Increases Firefly's &Param2& each time this effect deals DMG.

description.zh: 火垂在##剑击形态#4031#期间，「雪崩·巨剑」造成的&Param3&随时间提升。当火垂距离目标过远或者没有目标时，提升自身移动速度。
description.en: While Firefly is in ##Sword Form#4031#, increases the &Param3& dealt by Avalanche: Giant Sword over time.Increases Firefly's Movement SPD when she is too far from her target or has no target.

description.zh: 「雪崩·巨剑」造成伤害时，额外造成范围伤害，并附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。
description.en: When Avalanche: Giant Sword deals DMG, it deals additional AoE DMG and inflicts ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.

description.zh: 使火垂的绝招可附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。火垂施放绝招时，使光系主控角色获得护盾。
description.en: Firefly's Ultimate can inflict ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#.When Firefly casts the Ultimate, the Lux Main Trekker gains a shield.

description.zh: 火垂施放援护技时，提升队伍中光系角色的&Param3&。
description.en: When Firefly casts the Support Skill, increases the &Param3& of Lux Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 火垂在场期间，主控角色触发##光系印记#1015#，产生##落雷#4027#时，火垂提升自身&Param6&，同时提升自身附近目标&Param2&。
description.en: When the Main Trekker triggers ##Lux Mark#1015# and generates ##Thunderbolt#4027# while Firefly is on the battlefield, increases her own &Param6& and the &Param2& of nearby targets.

description.zh: 当全队均为光系角色时，提升全队的&Param3&。当火垂在场时额外提升全队的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the squad's &Param3& in an all-Lux squad.When Firefly is on the battlefield, additionally increases the squad's &Param3&.

description.zh: 主控技额外抛出种子。
description.en: The Main Skill tosses additional seeds.

description.zh: 主控技抛出的种子可变为麦豆射手：连续发射种子，造成伤害。
description.en: Seeds from the Main Skill will transform into Bean Shooters, which continuously throw seeds to deal DMG.

description.zh: 每发射一定数量的能量炮弹，下次普攻发射1颗巨型能量炮弹。
description.en: For every set number of energy rounds fired, the next Auto Attack fires 1 gigantic energy round.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&。普攻额外发射能量炮弹。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1&. Her Auto Attacks fire additional energy rounds.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&和种子伤害范围。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1& and the Attack Range of her seeds.

description.zh: 种子附加的移速降低效果可叠加，达到最大层数时，岭川对其造成的地系伤害提升。
description.en: The Movement SPD reduction from seeds can stack up. Once fully stacked, increases Ridge's Terra DMG to the affected target.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&。主控技和麦豆射手有概率额外抛出种子。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1&.The Main Skill and Bean Shooter have a chance to toss more seeds.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&和能量炮弹伤害范围。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1& and the Attack Range of her energy rounds.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&和普攻的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1& and her Auto Attack's &Param3&.

description.zh: 提升岭川闪避次数。 闪避时，提升岭川&Param1&。
description.en: Ridge can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param1& when dodging.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##地系印记：地脉#2029#。绝招触发##地系印记：地脉#2029#时，提升自身的&Param1&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#.When the Ultimate triggers ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&，延长主控技的普攻强化持续时间。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1& and the duration of her Main Skill's Auto Attack Enhancement.

description.zh: 提升岭川对中远距离的目标伤害和挥舞铲子炮的击退效果。
description.en: Increases Ridge's DMG to distant targets and enhances the knockback of the shovel cannon.

description.zh: 提升&Param1&和最后一击破韧效果。
description.en: Increases &Param1& and enhances the final strike's ability to Resilience Break.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，提升岭川的&Param1&。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Ridge's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升岭川&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Ridge's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放援护技后，会自动再次施放。
description.en: After casting the Support Skill, can automatically cast again.

description.zh: 提升援护技种子雨造成的&Param1&，缩短种子雨伤害间隔。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Support Skill's seed shower and reduces its Attack Interval.

description.zh: 「种球」持续时间延长，造成的&Param1&提升，可附加##地系印记：地脉#2029#。
description.en: Increases Seed Orb's duration and &Param1&. Can also inflict ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#.

description.zh: 提升「种球」造成的&Param1&和爆炸范围，「种球」的伤害可再次触发「种球」。
description.en: Increases Seed Orb's &Param1& and explosion radius. Dealing DMG can trigger another Seed Orb.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，随时间提升技能伤害，技能结束后清除该效果。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, gradually increases Skill DMG. Resets when the Skill ends.

description.zh: 援护技种子雨可降低目标&Param1&。
description.en: The Support Skill's seed shower can reduces the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技种子雨造成的&Param1&和范围。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and range of the Support Skill's seed shower.

description.zh: 岭川对附带「种球」的目标造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1& to target inflicted with Seed Orb by .

description.zh: 提升「种球」造成的&Param1&。「种球」造成伤害时，向最近的目标弹射种子。
description.en: Increases Seed Orb's &Param1&.When Seed Orb deals DMG, fires 1 seed to the nearest target.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&。绝招可附加##地系印记：地脉#2029#。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1&.The Ultimate can inflict ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#.

description.zh: 提升岭川&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Ridge's &Param1&.

description.zh: 附加「种球」的目标&Param1&降低。
description.en: Reduces the &Param1& of target inflicted with Seed Orb.

description.zh: 队伍中每存在1个地系角色，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 缩短主控技冷却时间。自动消耗次数，连续施放主控技。
description.en: Reduces Main Skill Cooldown. Automatically launch continuous attacks until available charges run out.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，提升下一次主控技的伤害。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, increases the DMG of the next Main Skill.

description.zh: 主控技对附带##光系印记：光明#2016#的目标造成伤害时，生成闪电链。
description.en: When the Main Skill deals DMG to a target with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, summons Chain Lightning.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，每秒额外造成伤害。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, deals additional DMG per second.

description.zh: 主控技对附带##光明#2016#的目标造成伤害时，额外造成伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill deals DMG to a target with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 璟麟普攻造成伤害时，提升下次主控技的伤害。
description.en: When Jinglin deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her next Main Skill's DMG.

description.zh: 主控技命中时，使目标受到技能伤害提升。
description.en: When the Main Skill hits a target, increases the Skill DMG taken by the target.

description.zh: 主控技间歇性对附带##光明#2016#的目标必定暴击，且暴击伤害提升。
description.en: The Main Skill will always Crit Hit against targets with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016# every few seconds. Also increases Crit DMG.

description.zh: 主控技对附带##光明#2016#的目标造成伤害时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When the Main Skill deals DMG to a target with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 主控技消灭目标时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When the Main Skill kills a target, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##光系印记：光明#2016#，产生「落雷」，触发时，提升&Param6&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016# and summon a Thunderbolt. When the mark is triggered, increases &Param6&.

name.en: Neutral Left, Live Right, Ground Below

description.zh: 璟麟受到近战伤害时，击退目标，造成伤害。
description.en: When taking Melee DMG, Jinglin knocks back targets and deals DMG.

description.zh: 璟麟触发##光明#2016#时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When Jinglin triggers ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 「雷电麒麟」存在时，提升璟麟&Param3&。
description.en: When the Lightning Qilin is on the field, Jinglin's &Param3& is increased.

description.zh: 缩短「雷电麒麟」伤害间隔，提升伤害。
description.en: Increases Lightning Qilin's DMG and reduces its Attack Interval.

description.zh: 「雷电麒麟」命中附带##光系印记：光明#2016#的目标时，提升璟麟&Param5&。
description.en: When the Lightning Qilin hits a target with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases Jinglin's &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升「闪电领域」伤害范围和造成伤害。
description.en: Increases Lightning Domain's Attack Range and DMG.

description.zh: 缩短「闪电领域」伤害间隔，提升伤害。
description.en: Increases Lightning Domain's DMG and reduces its Attack Interval.

description.zh: 目标进入和离开「闪电领域」时，受到光系伤害提升并眩晕。
description.en: When targets enter or leave the Lightning Domain, stuns them and increases the Lux DMG they take.

description.zh: 「闪电领域」额外造成伤害。
description.en: When the Lightning Domain emerges, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 「闪电领域」对精英及以上的目标造成伤害时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: When the Lightning Domain deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases &Param3&.

description.zh: 「闪电领域」持续时间延长，提升&Param4&。
description.en: Increases Lightning Domain's duration and &Param4&.

description.zh: 「闪电领域」造成伤害逐渐提升。
description.en: Lightning Domain's DMG increases over time.

description.zh: 缩短援护技冷却时间，并提升伤害。
description.en: Reduces Support Skill Cooldown and increases its DMG.

description.zh: 处于「闪电领域」范围内，主控角色提升&Param3&。
description.en: While the main Trekker is inside the Lightning Domain, increases their &Param3&.

description.zh: 绝招可附加##光系印记：光明#2016#，并提升伤害。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#. Also increases its DMG.

description.zh: 提升璟麟&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Jinglin's &Param2&.

description.zh: 「闪电领域」造成伤害时，有概率提升主控角色的&Param5&。
description.en: When the Lightning Domain deals DMG, there is a chance to increase the main Trekker's &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升光系角色暴击。
description.en: Increases Lux Trekkers' Crit Rate.

description.zh: 提升主控技的伤害和攻击次数。
description.en: Increases the Main Skill's DMG and number of slashes.

description.zh: 主控技「黯影交错」的攻击逐次加强。
description.en: When casting Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill), each strike becomes more powerful.

description.zh: 施放主控技获得##冥能#4014#。普攻可消耗##冥能#4014#发射「镰影」。
description.en: Casting the Main Skill grants ##Necro Energy#4014#. Auto Attacks consume ##Necro Energy#4014# to unleash Shadow Scythes.

description.zh: 施放普攻最后一段获得##冥能#4014#。普攻可消耗##冥能#4014#发射「镰影」。
description.en: The last strike of Auto Attack grants ##Necro Energy#4014#. Auto Attacks consume ##Necro Energy#4014# to unleash Shadow Scythes.

description.zh: 提升&Param2&和主控技期间移速。
description.en: Increases &Param2& and Movement SPD while casting the Main Skill.

description.zh: 主控技对附带##暗锁#2020#的目标伤害提升。
description.en: Increases the Main Skill's DMG to targets with ##Dark Shackles#2020#.

description.zh: 附近附带##暗锁#2020#的目标提升科洛妮斯的&Param2&。
description.en: Nearby targets with ##Dark Shackles#2020# increase Coronis' &Param2&.

description.zh: 「镰影」造成伤害时会喷溅毒液。提升科洛妮斯&Param3&。
description.en: Shadow Scythes will release venom when dealing DMG. Increases Coronis's &Param3&.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯触发##暗系印记：暗影#2018#时，目标&Param3&提升。
description.en: When Coronis triggers ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#, increases the target's &Param3&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##暗系印记：暗影#2018#，提升&Param2&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#. Increases &Param2&.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯提升闪避次数。闪避时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: Coronis can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param3& when dodging.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯闪避时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: When dodging, increases Coronis's &Param3&.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯闪避可穿越地形。提升&Param1&。
description.en: Coronis can dodge through barriers. Increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升绝招的&Param3&。横斩一刀命中目标越多，伤害越高。
description.en: Increases the Ultimate's &Param3&. The more targets the final horizontal slash hits, the higher the DMG will be.

description.zh: 绝招施放时，提升主控角色的&Param3&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases the main Trekker's &Param3&.

description.zh: 绝招对拥有韧性的目标伤害提升。
description.en: The Ultimate has increased DMG to targets with Resilience.

description.zh: 援护技可发射多发「镰影」。提升横斩和「镰影」的&Param3&。
description.en: The Support Skill unleashes multiple Shadow Scythes. Increases the &Param3& of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.

description.zh: 援护技可回射多发「镰影」。提升横斩和「镰影」的&Param3&。
description.en: The Support Skill unleashes multiple Shadow Scythes to the opposite direction. Increases the &Param3& of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.

description.zh: 援护技的横斩造成伤害时，有概率掉落「改造药水」，触碰后提升&Param4&。
description.en: When the Support Skill's horizontal sweep deals DMG, there is a chance to gain a Potent Potion, which increases her &Param4& when picked up.

description.zh: 援护技扯断锁链时会喷溅毒液。
description.en: Releases venom when breaking the chains with the Support Skill.

description.zh: 援护技的横斩对单个目标造成伤害后，会再次横斩。提升横斩和「镰影」的&Param3&。
description.en: Launches a second sweep after dealing DMG to a target inflicted with the Support Skill's horizontal sweep. Increases the &Param3& of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯附加##暗系印记：暗影#2018#时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When Coronis inflicts ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 横斩对精英及以上目标造成伤害时，科洛妮斯&Param3&提升。
description.en: When the horizontal sweep deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases Coronis' &Param3&.

description.zh: 当援护技的锁链连接多名目标时，提升扯断锁链的&Param2&。
description.en: When the Support Skill's chains bind multiple targets, increases &Param2& when Coronis breaks the chains.

description.zh: 援护技可牵引更强壮的目标。提升扯断锁链的&Param2&。
description.en: The Support Skill can pull stronger targets. Increases &Param2& when Coronis breaks the chains.

description.zh: 科洛妮斯提升&Param2&。绝招可附加##暗系印记：暗影#2018#。
description.en: Increases Coronis' &Param2&. The Ultimate can inflict ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#.

description.zh: 援护技造成伤害时，削减目标韧性。科洛妮斯提升&Param3&。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG, reduces the target's Resilience. Increases Coronis' &Param3&.

description.zh: 援护技扯断锁链造成伤害时，目标&Param3&提升。
description.en: When Coronis deals DMG by breaking the chains (Support Skill), increases the target's &Param3&.

description.zh: 提升暗系角色的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Umbra Trekkers' &Param2&.

description.zh: 花原造成多次普攻伤害后，额外造成范围风系普攻伤害。
description.en: After Nanoha deals multiple instances of Auto Attack DMG, deals additional AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，普攻时额外发射飞镖。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, Nanoha fires additional shurikens with her Auto Attacks.

description.zh: 向日葵飞镖变为多段伤害。
description.en: The sunflower shuriken can deal DMG multiple times.

description.zh: 向日葵飞镖的伤害和伤害范围提升。
description.en: Increases sunflower shuriken's DMG and Attack Range.

description.zh: 每次发射向日葵飞镖时，提升&Param5&和&Param6&。
description.en: Each time Nanoha throws the sunflower shuriken, increases &Param5& and &Param6&.

description.zh: 每名分身提升花原的&Param2&。
description.en: Each mirror image increases Nanoha's &Param2&.

description.zh: 花原造成伤害时，有概率提升&Param4&和&Param5&。
description.en: When Nanoha deals DMG, there is a chance to increase her &Param4& and &Param5&.

description.zh: 向日葵飞镖距离花原越远，造成的&Param2&越高。
description.en: The farther the sunflower shuriken is from Nanoha, the more &Param2& it deals.

description.zh: 主控技触发##风系印记#1017#时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When the Main Skill triggers ##Ventus Mark#1017#, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, increases &Param3&.

description.zh: 花原闪避次数提升。闪避时提升&Param3&。
description.en: Nanoha can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param3& when dodging.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，分身发射向日葵飞镖。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, the clones fire sunflower shurikens.

description.zh: 花原触发##风系印记#1017#时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: When Nanoha triggers ##Ventus Mark#1017#, increases her &Param3&.

description.zh: 分身可跟随主控角色进行战斗，提升分身的&Param2&。
description.en: The clones now follow the main Trekker into combat, their &Param2& increased.

description.zh: 提升花原&Param2&。绝招召唤分身的数量增加。
description.en: Increases Nanoha's &Param2&. The Ultimate will summon more mirror images.

description.zh: 提升花原&Param3&。分身存在时间延长。
description.en: Increases Nanoha's &Param3& and the duration of mirror images.

description.zh: 援护技对多个目标造成伤害时，增加发射轮次。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG to multiple targets, fires an additional round of shurikens.

description.zh: 援护技触发##风系印记#1017#时，产生爆炸并缩短冷却时间。
description.en: When the Support Skill triggers a ##Ventus Mark#1017#, causes an explosion and reduces Skill Cooldown.

description.zh: 援护技的飞镖可跟踪攻击目标，造成的技能伤害提升。
description.en: Shurikens from the Support Skill follow their targets, dealing increased Skill DMG.

description.zh: 援护技可附加标记。爆散向日葵消失时，引爆标记造成伤害。
description.en: The Support Skill can inflict Marks. When the exploding sunflower disappears, it detonates all Marks to deal DMG.

description.zh: 提升援护技对生命较高的目标造成的的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param3& dealt to targets with higher HP.

description.zh: 援护技对目标造成首次伤害时，提升花原&Param1&。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG for the first time, increases Nanoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 爆散向日葵产生时，分身向周围发射多枚小飞镖。
description.en: When an exploding sunflower is conjured, the clones fire multiple small shurikens at nearby targets.

description.zh: 提升援护技对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param1& dealt to elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 提升援护技的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param2&.

description.zh: 主控角色施放主控技时,提升花原&Param1&。
description.en: When the main Trekker casts the Main Skill, increases Nanoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 任意角色能量满时，提升花原援护技造成的&Param3&。
description.en: When an ally has full Energy, increases Nanoha's Support Skill &Param3&.

description.zh: 爆散向日葵消失时，分身向前发射多枚小飞镖。
description.en: When an exploding sunflower disappears, the clones fire multiple shurikens forward.

description.zh: 援护技触发##风系印记#1017#时，提升全队的&Param3&。
description.en: When the Support Skill triggers a ##Ventus Mark#1017#, increases the squad's &Param3&.

description.zh: 额外生成「飞叶」。
description.en: Summons more Flying Leaves.

description.zh: 提升「飞叶」的环绕速度。
description.en: Flying Leaves will rotate faster.

description.zh: 卡娜丝&Param1&提升。普攻时，有概率会额外发射「风能弹」。
description.en: Increases Canace's &Param1&. There is a chance to fire additional Ventus-imbued bullets with Auto Attacks.

description.zh: 施放主控技或队友施放援护技时，获得<color=#0abec5>涡量</color>，提升&Param3&。
description.en: When Canace casts the Main Skill or when squadmate casts a Support Skill, Canace gains <color=#0abec5>Vortex Energy</color> and &Param3& is increased.

description.zh: 根据「飞叶」数量提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the squad's &Param1& based on the number of Flying Leaves.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝&Param1&。「飞叶」轨迹范围以内的目标降低&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Canace's &Param1&.Reduces the &Param3& of targets caught in the Attack Range of Flying Leaves.

description.zh: 「飞叶」变大，提升&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the size of the Flying Leaf. Also increases its &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放主控技或队友施放援护技时，卡娜丝提升&Param1&。
description.en: When Canace casts the Main Skill or when a squadmate casts a Support Skill, her &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝触发##风系印记：风息#2017#的伤害。
description.en: When Canace triggers ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#, increases its DMG.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##风系印记：风息#2017#。触发时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#. When the mark is triggered, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝闪避次数。闪避后提升&Param1&。
description.en: Canace can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param1& after dodging.

description.zh: 卡娜丝闪避后可直接施放最后一段普攻，提升该次&Param1&。
description.en: Canace will launch the final strike of her Auto Attack right after dodging, and this strike's &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 「风能弹」造成伤害时，有概率使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When the Ventus-imbued bullets deal DMG, there is a chance to increase the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝&Param1&和伤害次数。
description.en: Increases Canace's &Param1& and the number of attacks.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，提升卡娜丝&Param1&。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Canace's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升卡娜丝&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Canace's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「花环」的伤害间隔缩短，且造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: Reduces Laurel Wreath's ATK Interval. Also increases its &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升「花环」范围和造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and Attack Range of the Laurel Wreath.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝技能伤害和「花环」环绕速度。
description.en: Increases Canace's Skill DMG and the rotation speed of the Laurel Wreath.

description.zh: 「花环」每环绕1圈，以主控角色为中心，造成伤害，并附加##风系印记：风息#2017#。
description.en: The Laurel Wreath spins around the main Trekker and deals DMG to surrounding targets.

description.zh: 「花环」造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When the Laurel Wreath deals DMG, increases the targets' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「花环」对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&提升，可击退更强壮的目标。
description.en: Increases Laurel Wreath's &Param1& to elite or higher-tier targets. It can now knock back stronger enemies.

description.zh: 「花环」造成的&Param1&提升，击破韧性时，提升目标&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Laurel Wreath's &Param1&. After breaking a target's Resilience, increases the target's &Param3&.

description.zh: 「花环」造成伤害时，提升后续技能伤害。
description.en: When the Laurel Wreath deals DMG, increases subsequent DMG of the Skill.

description.zh: 「花环」每环绕1圈，提升后续造成的技能伤害。
description.en: With each full spin of the Laurel Wreath, increases subsequent Skill DMG of the Skill.

description.zh: 绝招可附加##风系印记：风息#2017#，提升&Param1&。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#. Also increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升卡娜丝&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Canace's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「花环」每环绕1圈，提升主控角色&Param1&。
description.en: With each full spin of the Laurel Wreath, increases the main Trekker's &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中每存在1个风系角色，提升卡娜丝的&Param1&。
description.en: For each Ventus Trekker on the squad, increases Canace's &Param1&.

description.zh: ##泡泡#4013#在场时，杏子同样可通过伤害生成「风爆」。「风爆」生成时，提升全队&Param2&。
description.en: When ##Bubble#4013# is on the battlefield, if Ann deals DMG, there is a chance to create a Wind Burst. When a Wind Burst is created, increases the squad's &Param2&.

description.zh: 「风爆」可击飞弱小的目标，目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: The Wind Burst can blow away weak targets, and their &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: ##泡泡#4013#被召唤后，一定时间内可喷射激光。
description.en: After ##Bubble#4013# is summoned, it will fire a laser beam for a short duration.

description.zh: 召唤##泡泡#4013#时，提升队友的&Param1&。队友触发##风系印记#1017#时，##泡泡#4013#可额外喷射激光。
description.en: When summoning ##Bubble#4013#, increases the squad's &Param1&. When a squadmate triggers a ##Ventus Mark#1017#, ##Bubble#4013# will fire an additional laser beam.

description.zh: 「风爆」生成时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: When a Wind Burst is created, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: ##泡泡#4013#在场时，提升杏子的&Param1&和&Param3&。
description.en: When ##Bubble#4013# is on the battlefield, increases Ann's &Param1& and &Param3&.

description.zh: 提升「风爆」的生成概率。
description.en: The Wind Burst is more likely to be generated.

description.zh: 队友施放援护技时，提升随机队友和##泡泡#4013#的&Param1&。
description.en: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill, increases the &Param1& of ##Bubble#4013# and a random ally.

description.zh: 全队触发##风系印记#1017#时，有概率使杏子恢复生命。
description.en: When any Trekker in the squad triggers a ##Ventus Mark#1017#, there is a chance to restore Ann's HP.

description.zh: 提升杏子闪避次数。闪避时提升&Param1&。
description.en: Ann can dodge one more time. Increases her &Param1& when dodging.

description.zh: 杏子闪避时，可生成「风爆」，同时提升队友的&Param2&。
description.en: When dodging, Ann creates Wind Bursts and increases squadmates' &Param2&.

description.zh: 全队触发##风系印记#1017#时，有概率缩短技能冷却时间。
description.en: When any Trekker in the squad triggers a ##Ventus Mark#1017#, there is a chance to reduce Skill Cooldown.

description.zh: 杏子闪避穿越地形时，提升友方的&Param1&。
description.en: When Ann dodges through barriers, increases all other friendly units' &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，主控角色获得护盾。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, the main Trekker gains a shield.

description.zh: 杏子提升&Param2&。绝招可牵引目标。
description.en: Increases Ann's &Param2&. The Ultimate can pull in nearby targets.

description.zh: 绝招阻挡飞弹攻击时，主控角色获得能量。
description.en: When the Ultimate blocks hostile projectiles, the main Trekker gains Energy.

description.zh: 增加援护技的风墙数量。
description.en: The Support Skill will summon more walls of wind.

description.zh: 主控角色穿过风墙后，获得护盾，提升&Param4&。
description.en: After passing through the wall of wind, the main Trekker gains a shield and &Param4& is increased.

description.zh: 风墙可持续攻击附近目标，并使目标&Param4&提升。
description.en: The wall of wind will constantly attack nearby targets. Also increases their &Param4&.

description.zh: 主控角色的飞弹攻击穿过风墙后，提升飞弹的&Param2&。
description.en: When the main Trekker's projectiles pass through the wall of wind, increases their &Param2&.

description.zh: 援护技造成伤害时，降低目标&Param3&。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG, reduces targets' &Param3&.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，提升主控角色&Param3&。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, increases the main Trekker's &Param3&.

description.zh: 风墙阻挡飞弹攻击时，提升主控角色&Param3&。
description.en: When the wall of wind blocks hostile projectiles, increases the main Trekker's &Param3&.

description.zh: 援护技造成伤害时，目标&Param3&提升。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases targets' &Param3&.

description.zh: 风墙附近目标&Param2&提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of targets near the wall of wind.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the Support Skill.

description.zh: 风墙存在时，提升主控角色的&Param1&。
description.en: When a wall of wind is on the battlefield, increases the main Trekker's &Param1&.

description.zh: 主控角色穿过风墙时，提升&Param1&和&Param3&。
description.en: When the main Trekker passes through the wall of wind, increases her &Param1& and &Param3&.

description.zh: 有概率额外提升任意角色造成的风系伤害。
description.en: There is a chance to increase the Ventus DMG dealt by a random ally.

description.zh: 主控技结束时留下冰雾，降低敌方移动速度，提升己方普攻伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill ends, leaves a cloud of icy mist, reducing the Movement SPD of enemies caught inside the area and increasing the Auto Attack DMG of all friendly units in the same area.

description.zh: 使主控技不可蓄力，在完结时造成额外伤害。
description.en: The Main Skill cannot be charged. When it ends, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 提升技能伤害和攻击次数。
description.en: Increases Skill DMG and the number of attacks.

description.zh: 主控技期间免疫控制，提升伤害范围和技能伤害。
description.en: While casting the Main Skill, Freesia is immune to control, and her Attack Range and Skill DMG are increased.

description.zh: 主控技结束后提升攻击力。
description.en: When the Main Skill ends, increases Freesia's ATK.

description.zh: 施放主控技提升下次绝招伤害和##狂化#2014#状态下普攻伤害。
description.en: Casting this Main Skill increases the damage of the next Ultimate. Also increases Auto Attack DMG when Freesia is in ##Berserk#2014#.

description.zh: ##狂化#2014#状态下，施放主控技后，提升攻击力。
description.en: While Freesia is in ##Berserk#2014#, casting the Main Skill increases her ATK.

description.zh: 主控技有概率触发##碎冰#2007#或提升伤害。
description.en: The Main Skill has a chance to trigger ##Shattered Ice#2007# or increase the DMG dealt.

description.zh: 主控技攻击时持续落下冰斧造成伤害。
