description.zh: 绝招可附加##水流印记#2008#。绝招期间每当有角色触发##水流印记#2008#时，提升多娜&Param2&。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.While casting the Ultimate, when a Trekker triggers ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#, increases Donna's &Param2&.

description.zh: 「霜浪」对不同目标造成伤害时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Frost Wave deals DMG to different targets, increases own &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升队伍中水系角色的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the &Param3& of Aqua Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 解锁三段主控技「三垒打」。
description.en: Adds a third phase to the Main Skill: Three Base Hit.

description.zh: 主控技触发##光系印记#1015#后，强化「二垒打」。
description.en: When the Main Skill triggers a ##Lux Mark#1015#, enhances Two Base Hit.

description.zh: 提升主控技的伤害，触发印记时，目标受到技能伤害提升。
description.en: Increases Main Skill DMG. When triggering a mark, increases the Skill DMG taken by the target.

description.zh: 「二垒打」变为三连击，伤害提升。「&Param1&」后立刻施放「二垒打」造成额外伤害。
description.en: Two Base Hit becomes a 3-hit combo and its DMG is increased. Casting Two Base Hit immediately after &Param1& deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 密涅瓦施放主控技后，提升攻速和普攻伤害。
description.en: After Minova casts the Main Skill, increases her ATK SPD and Auto Attack DMG.

description.zh: 密涅瓦普攻命中目标时，提升下次主控技造成的伤害。
description.en: When Minova hits a target with an Auto Attack, increases her next Main Skill's DMG.

description.zh: 密涅瓦主控技持续期间，技能伤害逐次加强。
description.en: While Minova's Main Skill is active, each strike increases its Skill DMG.

description.zh: 主控技命中目标时，造成额外伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill hits a target, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，提升技能伤害。主控技冷却缩短。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, increases Skill DMG and reduces its Cooldown.

description.zh: 密涅瓦普攻造成伤害时，目标受到光系伤害提升。
description.en: When Minova deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases the Lux DMG taken by the target.

description.zh: 施放任意援护技时，提升密涅瓦&Param4&。
description.en: When casting any Support Skill, increases Minova's &Param4&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##光系印记#1015#，产生「落雷」。施放绝招后，提升技能伤害。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Lux Mark#1015# and summon a Thunderbolt. After casting the Ultimate, increases Skill DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，提升密涅瓦&Param4&。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, increases Minova's &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升绝招伤害，但增加能量消耗。
description.en: Increases Ultimate DMG and costs more Energy.

description.zh: 缩短绝招伤害间隔，提升绝招伤害。
description.en: Reduces the Ultimate's Attack Interval and increases its DMG.

description.zh: 绝招期间，满月和新月参战，协助攻击目标。
description.en: While the Ultimate is active, Vollara and Neuvira will help Minova attack the enemies.

description.zh: 提升技能伤害和「星芒」层数。
description.en: Increases Skill DMG and the stacks of Astral Hex.

description.zh: 提升「星芒」的伤害和伤害范围。
description.en: Increases the DMG and Attack Range of Astral Hex.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，主控角色获得护盾。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, the main Trekker gains a shield.

description.zh: 「星芒」造成伤害时，生成「流星」。主控角色拾取流星时获得「星芒」并提升攻击力。
description.en: When Astral Hex deals DMG, summons a Meteor. When the main Trekker picks it up, gains a stack of Astral Hex and their ATK is increased.

description.zh: 密涅瓦对附带「星芒」的目标造成的技能伤害提升。
description.en: Increases Minova's Skill DMG dealt to targets inflicted with Astral Hex.

description.zh: 主控角色对附带「星芒」的目标造成伤害时，造成额外伤害。
description.en: When the main Trekker deals DMG to a target inflicted with Astral Hex, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 每存在1个附带「星芒」的目标，提升「星芒」伤害。
description.en: Each target inflicted with Astral Hex increases the DMG of Astral Hex.

description.zh: 施放援护技时造成额外伤害并附加「星芒」。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, deals additional DMG and inflicts Astral Hex.

description.zh: 「星芒」造成伤害时，提升伤害范围内主控角色的&Param4&。
description.en: When Astral Hex deals DMG, increases the &Param4& of the main Trekker within its Attack Range.

description.zh: 绝招可附加##光系印记：光明#2016#。施放援护技后，提升下次绝招的伤害。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#. After casting the Support Skill, increases the DMG of the next Ultimate.

description.zh: 提升密涅瓦&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Minova's &Param2&.

description.zh: 援护技命中3个及以上目标时缩短冷却时间，提升全队&Param5&。
description.en: When the Support Skill hits 3 or more targets, reduces the Skill Cooldown and increases the squad's &Param5&.

description.zh: 队伍中每个光系角色都会提升全队攻击力。
description.en: Each Lux ally increases the squad's ATK.

description.zh: 提升主控技期间的移动速度和伤害范围。缩短主控技的伤害间隔。
description.en: While the Main Skill is active, increases Nazuka's Movement SPD and Attack Range. Reduces the Main Skill's Attack Interval.

description.zh: 提升主控技持续时间。技能中断时，会返还部分冷却时间。
description.en: Increases the duration of the Main Skill. If the Skill is interrupted, its cooldown is partially reduced.

description.zh: 吹风结束时，发射贯穿强风，造成伤害。
description.en: When the pinwheel stops, unleashes a burst of piercing gale, dealing DMG.

description.zh: 主控技额外造成伤害，使目标&Param4&提升，并可牵引弱小的目标。
description.en: The Main Skill deals additional DMG and increases the target's &Param4&. Also, the wind of the pinwheel can pull in weak targets.

description.zh: 主控技造成的&Param1&提升，并使目标&Param3&提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Main Skill and increases the targets' &Param3&.

description.zh: 主控技期间，提升自身&Param1&，且受击时，对攻击者造成伤害。
description.en: While the Main Skill is active, increases Nazuka's &Param1&. When hit, deals DMG to the attacker.

description.zh: 主控技期间，&Param1&随着持续时间提升。
description.en: When the Main Skill is active, &Param1& increases over time.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升夏花的&Param3&。主控技范围内的目标数量大于1时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Nazuka's &Param3&. When there are more than 1 target within the Main Skill's Attack Range, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升夏花&Param1&。绝招可触发##风系印记#1017#。
description.en: Increases Nazuka's &Param1&.The Ultimate can trigger ##Ventus Mark#1017#.

description.zh: 提升夏花闪避次数。闪避后，提升&Param1&。
description.en: Nazuka can dodge one more time.Increases her &Param1& after dodging.

description.zh: 主控技吹风结束后，短时间内提升&Param1&。
description.en: After the Main Skill ends, increases &Param1& for a short period of time.

description.zh: 普攻造成伤害时，有概率使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Auto Attacks deal DMG, there is a chance to increase the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升夏花&Param1&和绝招中龙卷风数量。
description.en: Nazuka can summon more tornados during her Ultimate, and her &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，夏花&Param1&提升。龙卷风持续时间延长。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Nazuka's &Param1& and the tornado's duration.

description.zh: 提升夏花&Param1&，绝招造成伤害时，提升目标的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Nazuka's &Param1&. When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's &Param3&.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，在风系主控角色位置连续生成多片「花瓣」，分别造成伤害，并附加##风系印记：风息#2017#。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, continuously creates a dozen Flower Petals at the main Ventus Trekker's location, each dealing DMG and inflicting ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#.

description.zh: 「花瓣」造成的&Param1&提升，可追踪目标。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Flower Petals, and they can follow targets.

description.zh: 提升「花海」持续时间。施放技能后一段时间，风系友方对「花海」外的目标造成伤害时，生成##「花海」#4004#。
description.en: Increases the duration of Flower Formation.After casting the skill, when another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to a target outside Flower Formation, creates another ##Flower Formation#4004#.

description.zh: 风系友方对「花海」中的目标造成伤害时，「花海」额外造成伤害。
description.en: When another friendly Ventus unit deals DMG to targets caught in Flower Formation, Flower Formation deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 「花瓣」造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Flower Petals deal DMG, increases the targets' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「花瓣」造成的&Param1&提升，有概率立即消灭普通目标。
description.en: The Flower Petal has a chance to kill a normal target immediately, and its &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 「花瓣」造成的&Param1&提升。每生成1片「花瓣」，提升夏花&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Flower Petal's &Param1&.For each Flower Petal created, increases Nazuka's &Param3&.

description.zh: 「花海」造成的&Param1&提升，「花海」范围内的目标数量大于2个时，伤害额外提升。
description.en: Increases Flower Formation's &Param1&. When there are 2 or more targets caught in Flower Formation, increases its DMG.

description.zh: 「花海」造成的&Param2&提升。「花海」消散时，造成伤害，并附加##风系印记：风息#2017#。
description.en: Increases the Flower Formation's &Param2&. When the Flower Formation dissipates, deals DMG and inflicts ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#.

description.zh: 提升夏花&Param1&。绝招可附加##风系印记：风息#2017#。
description.en: Increases Nazuka's &Param1&.The Ultimate can inflict ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#.

description.zh: 「花海」存在时，提升夏花&Param1&。
description.en: When there is a Flower Formation on the battlefield, increases Nazuka's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「花海」造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Flower Formation deals DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中风系先锋角色和均衡角色的&Param1&提升。
description.en: Increases all Vanguard and Versatile Ventus Trekkers' &Param1& in the squad.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，造成额外伤害，并获得更多子弹。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, deals additional DMG and increases Magazine Capacity.

description.zh: 「爆炎拳」每次攻击造成额外伤害。
description.en: Each strike of Fiery Punches deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 主控技命中时，附加「猫爪」标记。冬香对附带「猫爪」标记的目标造成普攻伤害时，附加额外伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill hits a target, inflicts Paw Print. When Fuyuka deals Auto Attack DMG to a target inflicted with Paw Print, deals additional damage.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，下次「爆炎拳」将被强化为「熔炎破」。
description.en: After Fuyuka casts the Main Skill, her next Fiery Punches are enhanced into Magma Burst.

description.zh: 「爆炎拳」和「熔炎破」造成的&Param2&提升，并且可触发##火焰印记#1016#。
description.en: Fiery Punches and Magma Burst deals increased &Param2& and can trigger ##Ignis Mark#1016#.

description.zh: 「爆炎拳」的第三段攻击，造成额外伤害。
description.en: The third strike of Fiery Punches deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 「爆炎拳」攻击后，「爆炎拳」造成的&Param4&提升。
description.en: When Fuyuka strikes with Fiery Punches, increases Fiery Punches' &Param4&.

description.zh: 施放主控技后，提升冬香&Param5&、&Param6&。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, increases Fuyuka's &Param5& and &Param6&.

description.zh: 冬香对目标累计多次伤害后，造成额外伤害。
description.en: Fuyuka's fourth attack on the same target deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 全队都是火系角色时，提升冬香&Param4&。
description.en: When Fuyuka squads up with Ignis Trekkers only, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升冬香对当前生命较低的目标造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Fuyuka's &Param3& to targets with low HP.

description.zh: 每间隔一段时间，提升「爆炎拳」和「熔炎破」的&Param2&。
description.en: Every few seconds, increases the &Param2& of Fiery Punches and Magma Burst.

description.zh: 冬香对精英及以上目标造成暴击时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: When Fuyuka lands a Crit Hit on an elite or higher-tier target, increases &Param4&.

description.zh: 绝招每次触发##火焰印记#1016#时，提升本次绝招期间冬香的&Param5&。
description.en: Each time the Ultimate triggers an ##Ignis Mark#1016#, increases Fuyuka's &Param5& during this Ultimate.

description.zh: 提升冬香的&Param3&和绝招的打击次数。
description.en: The Ultimate delivers more punches. Also increases Fuyuka's &Param3&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升冬香&Param4&。该效果随时间降低。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Fuyuka's &Param4&. This buff decays over time.

description.zh: 援护技的多段打击合并为一次爆发打击。
description.en: Combines the multiple strikes of the Support Skill into a single massive blow.

description.zh: 援护技结束时，冬香对周围目标造成额外伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill ends, Fuyuka deals additional DMG to nearby targets.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的伤害，伤害范围提升与持续时间。
description.en: Increases the DMG of the Support Skill. Also increases the its Attack Range and duration.

description.zh: 援护技造成的&Param3&随时间提升。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param3& over time.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，提升冬香&Param4&。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, increases Fuyuka's &Param4&.

description.zh: 援护技冲向目标时，造成额外伤害。
description.en: When Fuyuka casts the Support Skill, she charges at the target, dealing additional DMG.

description.zh: 冬香离场后，每间隔一段时间提升下个援护技的&Param4&。
description.en: When Fuyuka is not present, for every few seconds, increases the &Param4& of the next Support Skill.

description.zh: 援护技造成伤害时，造成额外伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill deals DMG, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 缩短援护技伤害间隔，并提升造成伤害。
description.en: Reduces the Support Skill's Attack Interval and increases its DMG.

description.zh: 冬香对精英及以上目标造成的&Param2&提升。
description.en: Increases Fuyuka's &Param2& against elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 援护技消灭目标时，提升冬香&Param5&。
description.en: When the Support Skill kills a target, increases Fuyuka's &Param5&.

description.zh: 援护技持续期间，冬香的&Param4&随时间提升。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, increases Fuyuka's &Param4& over time.

description.zh: 提升火系角色&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Ignis Trekkers' &Param2&.

description.zh: 缩短主控技冷却时间。##「南瓜影灵」#4007#消失时自爆。
description.en: Reduces Main Skill Cooldown. ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# will explode upon vanishing.

description.zh: 主控技可额外造成伤害。施放技能时，使场上##「南瓜影灵」#4007#消失并将其重新召唤。
description.en: The Main Skill deals additional DMG. When casting, removes all ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007# from the battlefield and summons them again.

description.zh: 「显影」状态下##「南瓜影灵」#4007#数量达到上限，提升其存在时间和&Param1&。
description.en: While in Exposure status, if the maximum number of ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007# are on the battlefield, increases their duration and &Param1&.

description.zh: 雾语造成伤害时，##「南瓜影灵」#4007#施放旋风斩。
description.en: When Mistique deals DMG, ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# will cast Whirlwind Slash.

description.zh: ##「南瓜影灵」#4007#消失时，附近目标&Param4&提升。
description.en: When a ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# vanishes, increases the &Param4& of nearby targets.

description.zh: ##「南瓜影灵」#4007#消失时雾语获得护盾。
description.en: When a ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# vanishes, Mistique gains a shield.

description.zh: ##「南瓜影灵」#4007#消失时，雾语提升&Param4&。
description.en: When a ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# vanishes, increases Mistique's &Param4&.

description.zh: ##「南瓜影灵」#4007#有概率提升伤害并附加眩晕。
description.en: ##Pumpka Phantom#4007# has a chance to increase its DMG and stun the target.

description.zh: 雾语附近##「南瓜影灵」#4007#的&Param2&获得提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007# near Mistique.

description.zh: 雾语普攻造成伤害时，恢复附近##「南瓜影灵」#4007#的生命。提升&Param2&。
description.en: When Mistique deals DMG with an Auto Attack, restores HP to nearby ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007#. Increases her &Param2&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##暗系印记#1019#。绝招触发##暗系印记#1019#时，提升攻击力。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Umbra Mark#1019#. When it triggers an ##Umbra Mark#1019#, increases Mistique's ATK.

description.zh: 提升##「南瓜影灵」#4007#的&Param1&和&Param3&。
description.en: Increases ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007#' &Param1& and &Param3&.

description.zh: 雾语提升闪避次数。闪避时，提升雾语和场上##「南瓜影灵」#4007#的&Param3&。
description.en: Mistique can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the &Param3& of Mistique and the ##Pumpka Phantoms#4007# on the battlefield.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，雾语献祭仆从提升绝招伤害。
description.en: When Mistique casts the Ultimate, sacrifices all of her minions to increase Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技或援护技时，提升雾语的能量获取效率。
description.en: Energy Charge Efficiency increases when Mistique casts the Main Skill or Support Skill.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，提升雾语绝招伤害。
description.en: When Mistique deals damage with the Ultimate, increases her Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 延长法阵的存在时间。提升##「提灯影灵」#4008#的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases the duration of the magic circle. Also increases the &Param2& of ##Lanterna Phantoms#4008#.

description.zh: 逐渐提升同一法阵召唤的##「提灯影灵」#4008#大小和&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the size and &Param3& of the ##Lanterna Phantoms#4008# summoned by the same magic circle over time.

description.zh: 增加援护技的法阵范围，可牵引目标。提升##「提灯影灵」#4008#在法阵内自爆的伤害。
description.en: Increases the radius of the Support Skill's magic circle that can pull in targets. When a ##Lanterna Phantom#4008# in the circle explodes, increases its DMG.

description.zh: 援护技的法阵可追踪目标。提升##「提灯影灵」#4008#在法阵内自爆的伤害。
description.en: The Support Skill's magic circle will follow targets. When a ##Lanterna Phantom#4008# in the circle explodes, increases its DMG.

description.zh: 缩短##「提灯影灵」#4008#的召唤间隔。
description.en: Reduces the intervals between each summon of a ##Lanterna Phantom#4008#.

description.zh: 提升##「提灯影灵」#4008#&Param2&。
description.en: Increases ##Lanterna Phantoms#4008#' &Param2&.

description.zh: 援护技有概率额外召唤##「提灯影灵」#4008#。
description.en: There is a chance the Support Skill can summon extra ##Lanterna Phantom#4008#.

description.zh: 援护技的法阵可持续造成伤害。
description.en: The Support Skill's magic circle will deal DMG over time.

description.zh: 法阵内的目标&Param2&提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of targets within the magic circle.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，主控角色获得护盾。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, the main Trekker gains a shield.

description.zh: 绝招提升伤害，可附加##暗系印记：暗影#2018#。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018# and its DMG is increased.

description.zh: 召唤##「提灯影灵」#4008#时，提升雾语&Param4&。
description.en: When Mistique summons a ##Lanterna Phantom#4008#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升暗系角色&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Umbra Trekkers' &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升「十字重斩」的攻击次数和&Param1&。获得##战术储能#4048#的冷却缩短。
description.en: Increases the number of attacks and &Param1& of Cross Slash. Reduces the cooldown for gaining ##Tactical Energy#4048#.

description.zh: 获得或消耗##战术储能#4048#时发射1枚炸弹。「十字重斩」消耗的##战术储能#4048#降低。
description.en: When ##Tactical Energy#4048# is gained or consumed, fires 1 bomb. Reduces the ##Tactical Energy#4048# consumed by Cross Slash.

description.zh: 「警戒」造成伤害的间隔缩短。施放「十字重斩」时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: Reduces Vigil's Attack Interval. When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「警戒」可额外造成范围风系技能伤害。施放主控技时，提升埃莉诺的&Param2&。
description.en: Vigil can deal additional AoE Ventus Skill DMG. When casting the Main Skill, increases Eleanor's &Param2&.

description.zh: 「十字重斩」可引发额外爆炸。提升「十字重斩」造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Cross Slash can trigger additional explosions. Increases Cross Slash's &Param2&.

description.zh: 施放「十字重斩」时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 普攻最后一击可触发##风系印记#1017#。「警戒」期间，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: The last Auto Attack strike can trigger ##Ventus Mark#1017#. During Vigil, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升「警戒」的伤害范围，提升「警戒」的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Vigil's Attack Range and its &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Main Skill, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招可触发##风系印记#1017#。提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: The Ultimate can trigger ##Ventus Mark#1017#. Increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 触发##风系印记#1017#时，提升全队风系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: When triggering ##Ventus Mark#1017#, increases the &Param1& of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 造成普攻伤害时，提升埃莉诺&Param1&。
description.en: When Auto Attack DMG is dealt, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 闪避冷却时间缩减。提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: Decreases Dodge cooldown. Increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升埃莉诺的&Param5&。绝招对目标造成伤害时，提升绝招造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Eleanor's &Param5&. When the Ultimate deals DMG to a target, increases the &Param1& it deals.

description.zh: 提升埃莉诺的&Param5&。全队风系角色施放主控技或援护技时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Eleanor's &Param5&. When any Ventus Trekker in the squad casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技的&Param1&。提升援护技引发的爆炸次数。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param1& and the number of explosions.

description.zh: 提升援护技的&Param3&。提升援护技的伤害范围和&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param3&, Attack Range, and &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升##哨兵#4050#的&Param5&。每次产生##哨兵#4050#时，延长场中已有##哨兵#4050#的存在时间。援护技可提升##哨兵#4050#造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases ##Sentries'#4050# &Param5&. Each time a ##Sentry#4050# is generated, extends the duration of all existing ##Sentries#4050# on the field. The Support Skill can increase ##Sentries'#4050# &Param1&.

description.zh: ##哨兵#4050#额外造成范围风系普攻伤害。场中每1名##哨兵#4050#可使全场##哨兵#4050#的&Param2&提升。
description.en: ##Sentries#4050# deal additional AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Each ##Sentry#4050# on the field increases &Param2& of all ##Sentries#4050# on the field.

description.zh: 提升援护技的&Param3&。提升援护技下砸爆炸的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param3& and &Param1& of its jump slam explosions.

description.zh: 援护技下砸爆炸造成伤害时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&和风系先锋主控角色的&Param5&。
description.en: When jump slam explosions from the Support Skill deal DMG, increases Eleanor's &Param1& and the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升援护技下砸爆炸造成的&Param1&和&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and &Param3& of jump slam explosions from the Support Skill.

description.zh: 提升##哨兵#4050#发射的子弹大小。提升##哨兵#4050#造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the size of bullets fired by ##Sentries#4050#. Increases ##Sentries'#4050# &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升##哨兵#4050#的&Param1&。##哨兵#4050#可提升风系先锋主控角色的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases ##Sentries'#4050# &Param1&. ##Sentries#4050# can increase the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's &Param3&.

description.zh: 触发##风系印记#1017#时，提升埃莉诺的&Param1&。
description.en: When triggering ##Ventus Mark#1017#, increases Eleanor's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招可附加##风系印记：风息#2017#。埃莉诺对目标造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: The Ultimate can inflict ##Ventus Mark: Breeze#2017#. When Eleanor deals DMG to a target, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升##哨兵#4050#造成的&Param1&。提升埃莉诺的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases ##Sentries'#4050# &Param1& and Eleanor's &Param3&.

description.zh: 埃莉诺造成伤害时，提升全队风系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: When Eleanor deals DMG, increases the &Param1& of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 全队为水系角色时，「清扫标记」数量上限提升，不会随时间消失，且每个「清扫标记」额外使艾蕾&Param2&提升。##「清扫标记」#4052#点亮数量达到上限时，可通过主控技施放绝招二段。
description.en: In an all-Aqua squad, increases the maximum number of Sweep Marks. They no longer disappear over time, and each Sweep Mark additionally increases Allie's &Param2&. When the number of lit ##Sweep Mark#4052# reaches the maximum, Ultimate Phase 2 can be cast via the Main Skill.

description.zh: 艾蕾施放普攻或主控技时，生成刀影，造成范围水系伤害，同时获得「清扫标记」。
description.en: When casting Auto Attacks or Main Skill, generates a blade shadow that deals AoE Aqua DMG and gains Sweep Mark.

description.zh: 「清扫标记」点亮数量达到上限时，可通过主控技施放绝招一段。通过任意方式施放绝招一段时，吸收所有「清扫标记」，并获得满层「清扫标记」增益。
description.en: When the number of lit Sweep Marks reaches the maximum, Ultimate Phase 1 can be cast via the Main Skill. Casting Ultimate Phase 1 by any means consumes all Sweep Marks and grants max stacks of Sweep Mark buffs.

description.zh: 绝招一段的「清扫架势」期间，额外提升艾蕾&Param1&。「清扫架势」期间，目标身上「潮」达到一定层数时，额外生成「汐」。「汐」强化为##「溟汐」#4054#。
description.en: While Sweeping Stance of Ultimate Phase 1 is active, additionally increases Allie's &Param1&.While Sweeping Stance is active, when the target's Tide reaches a certain number of stacks, additionally generates a Wave. Wave is enhanced to ##Abyssal Wave#4054#.

description.zh: 绝招二段造成的伤害均变为技能伤害。施放绝招二段或主控技时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: All DMG dealt by Ultimate Phase 2 becomes Skill DMG. When casting Ultimate Phase 2 or the Main Skill, increases own &Param1&.

description.zh: 获得「清扫标记」时，主控技和潜能「多重清扫」造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When gaining a Sweep Mark, increases the &Param1& dealt by the Main Skill and Multi Sweep (Potential).

description.zh: 施放绝招二段后，接下来一段时间内，刀影的触发间隔降低。全队为水系角色时，艾蕾&Param5&和&Param7&提升。
description.en: For a period of time after casting Ultimate Phase 2, the trigger interval of blade shadow is reduced. In an all-Aqua squad, increases Allie's &Param5& and &Param7&.

description.zh: 全队为水系角色时，绝招一段造成的伤害和普攻造成的伤害均变为印记伤害，同时艾蕾提升普攻伤害可额外提升印记伤害。艾蕾&Param4&降低。
description.en: In an all-Aqua squad, all DMG dealt by Ultimate Phase 1 and Auto Attacks becomes Mark DMG. Meanwhile, increasing Allie's Auto Attack DMG additionally increases her Mark DMG. Reduces Allie's &Param4&.

description.zh: 「清扫架势」期间，每通过##潮汐#4053#生成一定次数的「汐」，可获得1层「待清理点」，同时提升艾蕾&Param1&。退出「清扫架势」时，「待清理点」转化为「清扫标记」。
description.en: While Sweeping Stance is active, generating Wave via ##Tidal Wave#4053# a certain number of times grants 1 stack of Pending Chore and increases Allie's &Param1&. Upon exiting Sweeping Stance, Pending Chores are converted into Sweep Marks.

description.zh: 闪避或获得护盾时，提升艾蕾&Param1&。
description.en: When dodging or gaining a Shield, increases Allie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 长按闪避进入疾跑状态后一段时间，立即获得3个「清扫标记」。队伍中每有1个水系角色，提升艾蕾&Param2&。
description.en: A period of time after holding Dodge to dash, immediately gains 3 Sweep Marks.For each Aqua Trekker in the squad, increases Allie's &Param2&.

description.zh: 艾蕾&Param3&提升。全队为水系角色并且艾蕾处于「清扫架势」期间，普攻「家务用重斩」形态增强，&Param1&提升，可触发##水系印记#1018#产生##潮汐#4053#。
description.en: Increases Allie's &Param3&. In an all-Aqua squad and while Sweeping Stance is active, Housework Slash (Auto Attack) is enhanced, increasing its &Param1&. It can also trigger ##Aqua Mark#1018# to generate ##Tidal Wave#4053#.

description.zh: 艾蕾造成印记伤害时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Allie deals Mark DMG, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，属性提升。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, boosts stats.

description.zh: 绝招一段爆气范围和伤害增加。
description.en: Increases the burst range and DMG of Ultimate Phase 1.

description.zh: 绝招二段额外产生长刀虚影造成伤害。绝招二段造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: Ultimate Phase 2 creates an additional long blade phantom that deals DMG. Increases Ultimate Phase 2's &Param1& dealt.

description.zh: 「循环斩击」不断发射寒冰之刃，连续造成范围水系技能伤害。
description.en: Cycling Slashes fires Frost Blades, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG multiple times.

description.zh: 「循环斩击」次数提升和其造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: Cycling Slashes can deal more hits, and its &Param1& dealt is increased.

description.zh: 「收尾斩击」额外造成范围水系技能伤害。
description.en: Finishing Slash deals additional AoE Aqua Skill DMG.

description.zh: 「收尾斩击」时生成的冰晶会爆炸，再次造成范围水系技能伤害。
description.en: The ice crystals formed by Finishing Slash will explode, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG again.

description.zh: 「循环斩击」造成的&Param1&额外提升，对##破韧#1006#目标额外提升。
description.en: Additionally increases the &Param1& dealt by Cycling Slashes. It is further increased against targets with ##Resilience Break#1006#.

description.zh: 「循环斩击」命中的目标数量大于3个时，造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Cycling Slashes hits more than 3 targets, increases its &Param1& dealt.

description.zh: 艾蕾在场越久，造成的&Param1&越高。
description.en: The longer Allie is on the battlefield, the higher the &Param1& she deals.

description.zh: 「收尾斩击」和冰晶造成的&Param1&提升，对精英及以上目标额外提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by Finishing Slash and ice crystals. It is additionally increased against elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 「冰晶」范围提升。「收尾斩击」额外生成「冰晶」，分别造成范围水系技能伤害。
description.en: Increases the range of ice crystals. Finishing Slash generates more ice crystals, each dealing Aqua AoE Skill DMG.

description.zh: 辅助角色在场时，艾蕾造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When a Support Trekker is on the battlefield, increases &Param1& dealt by Allie.

description.zh: 艾蕾&Param1&提升。
description.en: Increases Allie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「收尾斩击」和冰晶命中的目标数量小于4个时，造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Finishing Slash and ice crystals hit fewer than 4 targets, increases their &Param1& dealt.

description.zh: 全队为水系角色时，全队属性提升。
description.en: In an all-Aqua squad, boosts the squad's stats.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔速射模式#4034#期间，激活技能「兔兔速射」，造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。当全队均为地系角色时，提升「兔兔速射」造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When Sparkla is in ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034#, activates Bunny Rapid Fire to deal damage. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.When in an All-Terra squad, increases Bunny Rapid Fire's &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升##兔兔速射模式#4034#造成的&Param4&。##兔兔速射模式#4034#对目标造成伤害时附加「星晶」，叠加满层时使目标「星晶化」。「星晶化」的目标处于眩晕状态，无法被附加「星晶」。##兔兔速射模式#4034#对「星晶化」的目标造成伤害时，造成额外伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: Increases the &Param4& of ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034#.When Sparkla deals damage with ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034# to a target, inflicts Stellar Crystal. At full stack, the target becomes Stellar Crystallized.Stellar Crystallized target will be stunned and immune to Stellar Crystal.When Sparkla deals damage with ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034# to a Stellar Crystallized target, deals additional damage. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔大开口模式#4033#期间，激活技能「兔兔吼」，造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。「兔兔吼」期间无法移动和闪避。当全队均为地系角色时，「兔兔吼」期间获得护盾，并且提升「兔兔吼」造成的&Param3&。
description.en: When Sparkla is in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, activates Bunny Roar to deal damage. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.When channeling Bunny Roar, Sparkla cannot move or dodge.When in an All-Terra squad, Sparkla gains a shield while Bunny Roar is active and increases the &Param3& of Bunny Roar.

description.zh: 提升##兔兔大开口模式#4033#造成的&Param1&。当斯帕克拉处于##兔兔大开口模式#4033#期间，随时间获得「速效柔光溶剂」，##兔兔大开口模式#4033#每次射击时，消耗「速效柔光溶剂」发射更多炮弹。##兔兔大开口模式#4033#结束时会清除所有「速效柔光溶剂」。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#.When Sparkla is in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, gains Instant Neo Solution over time. When in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, Sparkla can consume Instant Neo Solution to fire additional shells.When ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033# ends, nullifies all Instant Neo Solution.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔速射模式#4034#期间，触发##地系印记#1020#时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Sparkla triggers ##Terra Mark#1020# in ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔速射模式#4034#期间变为浮空，疾跑时可以继续攻击目标，并提升造成的&Param1&。
description.en: ##Bunny Rapid Fire Mode#4034# allows Sparkla to levitate. She can attack the target while dashing, and her &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉每次施放技能时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: Each Sparkla's skill cast increases Sparkla's &Param1&.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔大开口模式#4033#期间，每次射击时对前方造成伤害并击退目标，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: When Sparkla is in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, each shot deals damage to enemies in front and knocks them back. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉处于##兔兔大开口模式#4033#期间，获得霸体，提升自身&Param2&。##兔兔大开口模式#4033#发射的炮弹爆炸后，会在伤害范围内随机散布「诡雷」，造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: When Sparkla is in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, gains Super Armor and increases own &Param2&.After the shells fired in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033# explode, Booby Traps are randomly deployed within the blast radius. The traps can deal damage and trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉施放主控技变形时，提升自身&Param1&。在变形结束时，对自身周围目标造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: When Sparkla casts the Main Skill to transform, increases her &Param1&.When the transformation ends, deals DMG to nearby targets. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 提升斯帕克拉对远距离的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Sparkla's &Param1& to distant targets.

description.zh: 斯帕克拉进入##兔兔大开口模式#4033#时，获得护盾。斯帕克拉处于##兔兔大开口模式#4033#期间不移动时，自身&Param4&不断提升。
description.en: When Sparkla enters ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, gains a shield.When Sparkla remains stationary in ##Bunny Jaws Mode#4033#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 提升斯帕克拉闪避次数。闪避后，提升斯帕克拉的&Param1&。
description.en: Sparkla can dodge one more time.After dodging, increases Sparkla's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招结束时，在地上洒落「强效柔光溶剂」，主控角色吸收后提升其&Param2&。当地系角色吸收3瓶「强效柔光溶剂」后，造成普攻伤害时，斯帕克拉附加额外伤害。
description.en: When the Ultimate ends, drops bottles of Potent Neo Solution on the ground. When the Main Trekker absorbs them, increases their &Param2&.When a Terra Trekker absorbs 3 bottles of Potent Neo Solution and deals Auto Attack DMG, Sparkla deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 绝招发射的「兔兔礼花炮」的伤害范围提升，直接消灭范围内普通目标，并对精英和首领目标造成持续伤害。
description.en: Increases the Attack Range of the Bunny Firework Cannon fired by the Ultimate. Instantly eliminates normal targets within range and deals damage to elite and boss targets over time.

description.zh: 绝招触发##地系印记#1020#时，提升本次绝招造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When the Ultimate triggers ##Terra Mark#1020#, increases the &Param2& of this Ultimate.

description.zh: 提升援护技造成的&Param2&。当全队为地系角色时，提升援护技每轮发射的「兔兔礼花」数量。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& of the Support Skill.When Sparkla casts the Support Skill in an all-Terra squad, increases the number of Bunny Fireworks fired per volley.

description.zh: 援护技期间每次发射「兔兔礼花」，斯帕克拉都会积蓄能量。援护技结束时，斯帕克拉将消耗所有能量提升自身&Param2&。然后驾驶轮椅冲向目标，造成伤害。
description.en: When casting the Bunny Firework, Sparkla gains Energy each time a rocket is fired.When the Support Skill ends, Sparkla consumes all Energy to increase her &Param2&.She then charges toward the target in her wheelchair, dealing damage.

description.zh: 提升斯帕克拉的&Param4&。援护技结束后，斯帕克拉会持续跟随地系主控角色，发射子弹攻击目标，造成伤害。

description.en: Increases Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with ##Chill#1027#/##Frozen#1002#.

description.zh: 提升援护技高速连斩的&Param1&和施放次数。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and amount of casts of the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes.

description.zh: 提升援护技高速连斩的&Param1&，且暴击时，会立即再次施放高速连斩。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes. When landing a Crit Hit, immediately casts rapid combo slashes again.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，连续生成「镜影」。

description.en: Mirror Images of the Support Skill explode upon hits, dealing additional AoE Aqua DMG.

description.zh: 援护技的高速连斩暴击时，提升后续高速连斩的暴击伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes land a Crit Hit, increases the Crit DMG of the subsequent rapid combo slashes.

description.zh: 援护技每进行一次高速连斩，提升高速连斩造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Every time the Support Skill casts rapid combo slashes, increases their &Param1& dealt.

description.zh: 提升千都世&Param1&和援护技高速连斩的施放次数。
description.en: Increases Chitose's &Param1& and the available casts of rapid combo slashes of the Support Skill.

description.zh: 提升「镜影」&Param1&。「镜影」消灭目标时，提升其他「镜影」&Param3&。
description.en: Increases Mirror Images' &Param1&. When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases other Mirror Images' &Param3&.

description.zh: 提升「镜影」对生命低于70%的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Mirror Images' &Param1& to targets at less than 70% HP.

description.zh: 提升千都世和「镜影」的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Chitose and the Mirror Image's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升千都世&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Chitose's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「镜影」命中目标时，提升「镜影」&Param1&。
description.en: When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases Mirror Images' &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中每存在1名水系角色，提升千都世&Param1&。
description.en: For each Aqua Trekker on the squad, increases Chitose's &Param1&.

description.zh: 主控技「夜昙」射击时，产生多次「天诛」，可触发##暗系印记#1019#。乙叶产生「天诛」时，缩减绝招冷却时间，获得能量。
description.en: When shooting with Nightbloom (Main Skill), summons Doomfall multiple times. Can trigger ##Umbra Mark#1019#. Upon summoning Doomfall, reduces Ultimate Cooldown and gains Energy.

description.zh: 主控技「夜昙」移动后击退周围目标，同时获得护盾。该护盾持续期间，乙叶持续获得能量，同时产生「天诛」。
description.en: Moving with Nightbloom (Main Skill) knocks back nearby targets and gains a Shield. While the Shield lasts, continuously gains Energy and summons Doomfall.

description.zh: 主控技「夜昙」发射的子弹可额外弹射多次。
description.en: Bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) can ricochet multiple additional times.

description.zh: 主控技「夜昙」发射的子弹爆炸可产生多枚小子弹。
description.en: The explosion of bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) can generate multiple small bullets.

description.zh: 乙叶普攻造成伤害时，产生「天诛」。
description.en: Dealing Auto Attack DMG summons Doomfall.

description.zh: 乙叶普攻攻击时，提升&Param1&和&Param3&。
description.en: Otoha's Auto Attack increases &Param1& and &Param3&.

description.zh: 施放主控技「夜昙」时，提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting Nightbloom (Main Skill), increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升主控技「夜昙」可使用次数。施放主控技时，提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the uses of Nightbloom (Main Skill). When casting the Main Skill, increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升主控技「夜昙」对附带##暗锁#2020#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases &Param1& dealt by Nightbloom (Main Skill) against targets inflicted with ##Dark Shackles#2020#.

description.zh: 提升乙叶闪避次数。闪避时，提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Otoha's dodges. When dodging, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 乙叶触发##暗系印记#1019#时，提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: When Otoha triggers an ##Umbra Mark#1019#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 主控技「夜昙」移动期间不会受到伤害。提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: Immune to DMG while moving during Nightbloom (Main Skill). Increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招「空华」可触发##暗系印记#1019#。提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: Void Blossom (Ultimate) triggers ##Umbra Mark#1019#. Increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招「空华」抛出的花伞可牵引周围目标。提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: The parasol thrown by Void Blossom (Ultimate) pulls in nearby targets. Increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升绝招「空华」对附带##暗锁#2020#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by Void Blossom (Ultimate) to targets inflicted with ##Dark Shackles#2020#.

description.zh: 乙叶施放绝招「空华」时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: Increases &Param1& when Otoha casts Void Blossom (Ultimate).

description.zh: 提升「离魂」的持续时间。乙叶造成绝招伤害时，缩减绝招冷却时间，获得一定能量。提升乙叶的&Param4&、&Param6&。
description.en: Increases Soul Rend duration. When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, reduces Ultimate Cooldown and gains Energy. Increases Otoha's &Param4& and &Param6&.

description.zh: 暗系主控角色对附带「离魂」的目标造成伤害时，乙叶产生「天诛」造成范围伤害，同时乙叶获得能量。提升乙叶的&Param3&、&Param5&。
description.en: When the Main Umbra Trekker deals DMG to a target with Soul Rend, Otoha summons Doomfall, dealing AoE DMG and gaining Energy. Increases Otoha's &Param3& and &Param5&.

description.zh: 「碎雨」推进时，额外产生轰击造成范围伤害。轰击有概率造成多次伤害。提升「碎雨」造成的&Param4&。提升乙叶的&Param6&。
description.en: When Weeping Sky advances, summons additional bombardments to deal AoE DMG. Bombardments have a chance to deal DMG multiple times. Increases &Param4& dealt by Weeping Sky. Increases Otoha's &Param6&.

description.zh: 全队均为暗系角色时，额外产生「碎雨」。提升「碎雨」对附带##暗系印记#1019#或##暗锁#2020#的目标造成的&Param2&。提升乙叶的&Param4&。
description.en: In an all-Umbra squad, summons additional Weeping Sky. Increases &Param2& dealt by Weeping Sky to targets inflicted with ##Umbra Mark#1019# or ##Dark Shackles#2020#. Increases Otoha's &Param4&.

description.zh: 乙叶造成绝招伤害时，有概率发动多次射击造成伤害。提升乙叶的&Param4&。
description.en: When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, there is a chance to shoot multiple times. Increases Otoha's &Param4&.

description.zh: 援护技「破刃」冷却期间，提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: When Shattered Edge (Support Skill) is on cooldown, increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 任意暗系角色施放主控技或援护技时，提升乙叶的&Param1&和&Param5&。
description.en: When any Umbra Trekker casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Otoha's &Param1& and &Param5&.

description.zh: 降低「碎雨」向前推进的速度。提升「碎雨」造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Reduces the forward movement speed of Weeping Sky and increases its &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升「碎雨」对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Weeping Sky's &Param1& against elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 全队都为暗系角色时，提升暗系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: In an all-Umbra squad, increases Umbra Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中每名暗系角色，提升全队暗系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: Each Umbra Trekker in the squad increases all Umbra teammates' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「碎雨」造成伤害时，提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: When Weeping Sky deals DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招「空华」可附加##暗系印记:暗影#2018#。提升乙叶的&Param1&。
description.en: Void Blossom (Ultimate) inflicts ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#. Increases Otoha's &Param1&.

description.zh: 靠近##恶魔音响#4016#时，普攻最后一段变为范围伤害。
description.en: When Caramel is near ##Demonic Boombox#4016#, the last strike of her Auto Attack deals AoE DMG.

description.zh: 提升焦糖&Param1&。触发印记后，普攻直接施放最后一段。
description.en: Increases Caramel's &Param1&. After triggering a mark, directly launches the last strike of her Auto Attack.

description.zh: 提升焦糖&Param2&，##恶魔音响#4016#跃动时额外造成伤害。
description.en: Increases Caramel's &Param2&. Increases the additional DMG dealt by ##Demonic Boombox#4016# when pulsating.

description.zh: 提升焦糖&Param1&，提升##恶魔音响#4016#跃动的伤害范围。
description.en: Increases Caramel's &Param1&. Increases ##Demonic Boombox#4016#'s Attack Range when pulsating.

description.zh: 焦糖施放普攻最后一段时，提升移动速度，攻击速度。
description.en: When Caramel launches the last strike of her Auto Attack, increases her Movement SPD and ATK SPD.

description.zh: 施放主控技时，提升焦糖&Param1&。
description.en: When Caramel casts the Main Skill, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 焦糖靠近##恶魔音响#4016#时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: When Caramel is near ##Demonic Boombox#4016#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，##恶魔音响#4016#同时演奏。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, ##Demonic Boomboxes#4016# plays at the same time.

description.zh: 焦糖靠近##恶魔音响#4016#时，提升##恶魔音响#4016#的&Param1&。
description.en: When Caramel is near ##Demonic Boombox#4016#, increases ##Demonic Boombox#4016#'s &Param1&.

description.zh: 焦糖闪避穿越地形时，提升攻击力。

description.zh: 触发##暗系印记：暗影#2018#时，提升攻击力。
description.en: When triggering an ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#, increases ATK.

description.zh: ##恶魔音响#4016#跃动时，提升其&Param1&。
description.en: When ##Demonic Boombox#4016# is pulsating, increases its &Param1&.

description.zh: ##恶魔音响#4016#连接线可持续伤害目标。
description.en: ##Demonic Boombox#4016#'s cables constantly deal DMG to the target.

description.zh: 提升绝招对附带##暗灼#2028#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Ultimate's &Param1& to targets inflicted with ##Dark Burn#2028#.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升焦糖&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases Caramel's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，提升其造成的&Param1&。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases &Param1& it deals.

description.zh: 提升援护技的横扫段数和造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the number of horizontal sweeps and &Param1& of the Support Skill.

description.zh: 援护技的横扫造成伤害时，缩短冷却时间，同时坠落音响。
description.en: When the Support Skill's horizontal sweep deals DMG, reduces its Cooldown and drops a boombox.

description.zh: 援护技的音符可弹射。
description.en: The Support Skill's Musical Notes can ricochet.

description.zh: 增加援护技的音符数量。
description.en: The Support Skill can release more Musical Notes.

description.zh: 提升横扫的造成的&Param1&，并可牵引目标。
description.en: Increases &Param1& of the horizontal sweeps. Can pull targets.

description.zh: 提升横扫的伤害范围和造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Attack Range and &Param1& of the horizontal sweep.

description.zh: 提升横扫对附近目标的造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases horizontal sweep's &Param1& to nearby targets.

description.zh: 提升援护技的音符对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases &Param1& of the Support Skill's Notes dealt to elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 援护技触发##暗系印记：暗影#2018#时，提升攻击力。
description.en: When the Support Skill triggers ##Umbra Mark: Gloom#2018#, increases ATK.

description.zh: 提升援护技对附带##暗灼#2028#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the Support Skill's &Param1& to targets inflicted with ##Dark Burn#2028#.

description.en: The Support Skill's Notes will now attack the same target. After dealing DMG to the same target, increases the Notes' &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升暗系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Umbra Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「肃杀」状态下，提升格芮移动速度和&Param1&，且「肃杀」状态不再受限于「铁笼」附近。
description.en: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases her Movement SPD and &Param1&. Lethal status remains active even when Gerie is not at the vicinity of Iron Cage.

description.zh: 「肃杀」状态下，提升格芮普攻范围，可触发##地系印记#1020#。普攻造成伤害时，额外造成地系普攻伤害。
description.en: When Gerie is in Lethal status, increases the range of her Auto Attacks, and she can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#. When an Auto Attack deals DMG, it also deals Terra Auto Attack DMG.

description.zh: 提升「铁笼」链接的目标数量和&Param1&。
description.en: The Iron Cage can link more targets and its &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 格芮对「铁笼」链接的目标造成普攻伤害时，所有链接目标额外受到伤害。
description.en: When Gerie deals Auto Attack DMG to targets linked by the Iron Cage, these targets receive additional DMG.

description.zh: 格芮普攻造成伤害时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Gerie deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her &Param1&.

description.en: Increases Gerie's &Param1&.Increases her Auto Attack DMG to targets with ##Broken Resilience#1006#.

description.zh: 提升格芮&Param1&。「铁笼」消失时，如果格芮处于「肃杀」状态，则该状态延续4秒。
description.en: Increases Gerie's &Param1&.If Gerie is in Lethal status when the Iron Cage disappears, the status lasts 4s longer.

description.zh: 降低「铁笼」链接目标的&Param1&。提升格芮对移速降低目标造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Reduces the &Param1& of targets linked by the Iron Cage.Increases Gerie's &Param3& to slowed targets.

description.zh: 队友施放援护技时，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill, increases Gerie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升格芮闪避次数。闪避后，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: Gerie can dodge one more time.Increases her &Param1& after dodging.

description.zh: 队伍中每有1个地系角色，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases Gerie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升「铁笼」造成的&Param1&，延长「铁笼」持续时间。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and duration of Iron Cage.

description.zh: 提升「铁笼」造成的&Param1&和链接距离。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and range of Iron Cage.

description.zh: 提升格芮&Param1&。绝招额外生成巨型链铲，造成伤害。

description.zh: 提升格芮&Param1&。己方对目标触发##地系印记#1020#时，额外提升格芮对其造成的&Param5&。
