description.zh: 施放绝招时，附近目标受到格芮伤害提升。普通目标会被##恐惧#4501#2秒。
description.en: When Gerie casts the Ultimate, increases her nearby targets' DMG taken. Normal targets will be inflicted with ##Fear#4501# for 2s.

description.zh: 提升援护技链铲造成的&Param1&。援护技额外生成链铲，造成伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Support Skill's chained spades. The Support Skill now conjures up more chained spades to deal DMG.

description.zh: 提升援护技链铲造成的&Param1&。回收链铲时，每根链铲分别造成伤害。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Support Skill's chained spades. When the chained spades are withdrawn, each spade deals DMG.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，格芮驻场一段时间，自身和链铲位置每秒生成地震波，分别造成伤害。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, Gerie remains on the battlefield for a period of time and creates seismic waves at her and the chained spades' location every second to deal DMG.

description.zh: 提升援护技地震波造成的&Param1&和范围。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and Attack Range of the Support Skill's seismic waves.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, increases Gerie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技链铲对生命低于70%目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of the Support Skill's chained spades to targets at less than 70% HP.

description.zh: 援护技链铲命中目标时，额外造成伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill's chained spade hits a target, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 施放援护技时，每秒提升技能伤害，技能结束后清除该效果。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, increases Skill DMG every second. Resets after the Skill ends.

description.zh: 援护技的地震波结束时，再次造成伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill's seismic waves stop, deals DMG again.

description.zh: 格芮触发##地系印记#1020#时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Gerie triggers a ##Terra Mark#1020#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 队友施放技能或绝招时，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: When a squadmate casts a skill or Ultimate, increases Gerie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技地震波造成的&Param1&和破韧效率。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& and Resilience Break Efficiency of the Support Skill's seismic waves.

description.zh: 队伍中每有1个地系角色，提升格芮&Param1&。
description.en: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases Gerie's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放主控技后产生雷电区域，持续造成伤害。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, creates a Thunder Domain that deals DMG over time.

description.zh: 激光对目标附加「感电」，攻击「感电」目标时造成额外伤害。
description.en: The laser inflicts Shock on targets. When attacking Shocked targets, deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 长按主控技增加横扫次数。
description.en: Hold the Main Skill button to launch more horizontal sweeps.

description.zh: 主控技中横扫提升下次激光伤害。
description.en: Each of the Main Skill's horizontal sweep increases the next laser beam's DMG.

description.zh: 施放主控技后提升攻速和普攻伤害。
description.en: After casting the Main Skill, increases Laru's ATK SPD and Auto Attack DMG.

description.zh: 主控技中横扫后持续造成伤害并牵引目标。
description.en: After launching a horizontal sweep with the Main Skill, pulls in targets and deals DMG over time.

description.zh: 菈露对目标造成的技能伤害逐渐提升。
description.en: Increases Laru's Skill DMG dealt to targets over time.

description.zh: 菈露普攻对附带##光系印记：光明#2016#的目标造成伤害时，提升下次主控技的伤害。
description.en: When Laru's Auto Attack deals DMG to a target inflicted with ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases the Skill DMG of her next Main Skill.

description.zh: 主控技触发##光系印记：光明#2016#时产生闪电链攻击周围目标。
description.en: When the Main Skill triggers a ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, summons Chain Lightning to attack nearby targets.

description.zh: 菈露疾跑中断时造成伤害。
description.en: Laru deals DMG when her dash is interrupted.

description.zh: 对首领目标造成伤害时，提升攻击力。
description.en: When Laru deals DMG to a boss target, increases her ATK.

description.zh: 横扫命中目标时，激光对其造成伤害提升。
description.en: When the horizontal sweep hits a target, increases the laser's DMG dealt to the target.

description.zh: 主控技触发##光系印记：光明#2016#时，提升绝招伤害。
description.en: When the Main Skill triggers ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases the Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 绝招掷出的长矛持续造成伤害。
description.en: The lance from the Ultimate deals DMG over time.

description.zh: 绝招命中精英及以上目标时伤害提升，并获得能量。
description.en: When the Ultimate hits an elite or higher-tier target, increases its DMG. Also grants Laru Energy.

description.zh: 绝招命中不同目标时提升攻击力。
description.en: Each time the Ultimate hits a different target, increases ATK.

description.zh: 「雷域」持续造成伤害。
description.en: Thunder Domain will deal DMG over time.

description.zh: 援护技生成更多「雷域」并提升造成的伤害。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, creates more Thunder Domains and increases their DMG.

description.zh: 「雷域」中心位置造成额外伤害。
description.en: The center of the Thunder Domain deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 提升「雷域」的伤害并使其出现在目标位置。
description.en: Creates a Thunder Domain at the target's location and increases its DMG.

description.zh: 援护技结束后对主控角色周围目标持续造成伤害。
description.en: When the Support Skill ends, deals constant DMG to the targets near the main Trekker.

description.zh: 「雷域」对同一个目标造成的伤害逐渐提升。
description.en: Increases the Thunder Domain's DMG to the same target over time.

description.zh: 「雷域」可击飞目标，提升对失控目标造成的伤害。
description.en: Thunder Domain can knock targets into the air. Also increases its DMG to airborne targets.

description.zh: 施放援护技时造成额外伤害，且援护技期间持续造成额外伤害。
description.en: When casting the Support Skill, deals additional DMG. While the Support Skill is active, deals additional DMG constantly.

description.zh: 援护技每次命中不同目标，提升技能伤害。
description.en: Each time the Support Skill hits a different target, the Skill DMG is increased.

description.zh: 援护技触发##光系印记：光明#2016#时，提升&Param5&。
description.en: When the Support Skill triggers a ##Lux Mark: Radiance#2016#, increases &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升菈露攻击力。
description.en: Increases Laru's ATK.

description.zh: 队友施放主控技后，提升菈露的下次援护技伤害。
description.en: After a squadmate casts a Main Skill, increases the DMG of Laru's next Support Skill.

description.zh: 提升光系角色技能伤害。
description.en: Increases the Skill DMG of Lux Trekkers.

description.zh: 「雪兔」造成普攻伤害时附加「电音」，叠加满后造成额外伤害。
description.en: When dealing Auto Attack DMG, Snow Rabbit inflicts Electro Music that deals additional DMG upon reaching the max stack limit.

description.zh: 主控技生成的「雪兔」造成技能伤害时附加「电音」，叠加满后造成额外伤害。
description.en: The Main Skill summons a Snow Rabbit that inflicts Electro Music when dealing Skill DMG, dealing additional DMG upon reaching the max stack limit.

description.zh: 「夜兔」普攻时对附近目标发射追踪弹，追踪弹造成伤害使「夜兔」获得「月瞳」，提升伤害。
description.en: Night Rabbit fires tracking bullets at nearby targets during Auto Attacks. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit gains Moongaze, increasing its DMG.

description.zh: 主控技生成的「夜兔」射击时对附近目标发射追踪弹，追踪弹造成伤害使「夜兔」获得「月瞳」，提升伤害。
description.en: Night Rabbit summoned by the Main Skill fires tracking bullets at nearby targets when attacking. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit gains Moongaze, increasing its DMG.

description.zh: 提升「雪兔」普攻伤害，普攻发射的子弹可穿透目标。
description.en: Increases Snow Rabbit's Auto Attack DMG. Bullets from Auto Attacks can pierce through targets.

description.zh: 主控技生成更多「雪兔」。主控技持续期间，提升所有「雪兔」的&Param2&。
description.en: The Main Skill summons more Snow Rabbits.While the Main Skill is active, increases all Snow Rabbits' &Param2&.

description.zh: 「雪兔」触发##光系印记#1015#时，提升所有「雪兔」的&Param4&。
description.en: When a Snow Rabbit triggers ##Lux Mark#1015#, increases all the Snow Rabbits' &Param4&.

description.zh: 根据「夜兔」普攻命中的目标数量，提升其下次普攻造成的伤害。
description.en: Based on the number of targets hit by Night Rabbit's Auto Attack, increases the DMG of its next Auto Attack.

description.zh: 「夜兔」的导弹命中后分裂，对附近目标造成伤害。
description.en: Night Rabbit's missile splits after hitting a target, dealing DMG to nearby targets.

description.zh: 主控技「&Param10&」持续期间，提升希娅移动速度。当希娅近距离内没有目标时，提升&Param3&。
description.en: While &Param10& (Main Skill) is active, increases Shia's Movement SPD.When there are no nearby targets, increases Shia's &Param3&.

description.zh: 提升希娅对生命低于50%目标的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Shia's &Param2& to a target with less than 50% HP.

description.zh: 主控技生成的「夜兔」伤害间隔缩短，并提升&Param2&。
description.en: Reduces the Attack Interval of Night Rabbits summoned by the Main Skill and increases &Param2&.

description.zh: 希娅闪避次数提升1次。触发##光系印记#1015#时，提升&Param4&。
description.en: Shia can dodge one more time.When Shia triggers ##Lux Mark#1015#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 绝招每次造成暴击时，提升希娅&Param4&。
description.en: Every time the Ultimate lands a Crit Hit, increases Shia's &Param4&.

description.zh: 希娅施放绝招时，若队伍中其他角色的绝招均处于冷却中，提升本次绝招伤害。
description.en: When Shia casts the Ultimate, if other squadmates' Ultimates are all on cooldown, increases this cast's Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 提升希娅绝招造成的光系伤害，缩短绝招伤害间隔。
description.en: Increases Shia's Ultimate Lux DMG and reduces the Ultimate's Attack Interval.

description.zh: 施放援护技后，生成「雪兔」跟随主控角色，攻击目标。
description.en: After casting the Support Skill, summons Snow Rabbits that follow the main Trekker and attack targets.

description.zh: 施放援护技后，生成「夜兔」，攻击目标。
description.en: After casting the Support Skill, summons Night Rabbits that attack targets.

description.zh: 提升希娅冲浪次数和冲浪伤害。
description.en: Increases the number of times Shia can surf and the DMG dealt by each ride.

description.zh: 希娅冲浪后残留带电区域，持续造成伤害。
description.en: Shia leaves behind a charged area as she surfs, dealing DMG over time.

description.zh: 根据在场的无人机数量，提升无人机的伤害。
description.en: Increases the drones' DMG based on the number of drones on the battlefield.

description.zh: 「雪兔」造成伤害时，提升&Param2&。
description.en: When Snow Rabbit deals DMG, increases &Param2&.

description.zh: 希娅触发##光系印记#1015#时，提升「夜兔」&Param2&。
description.en: When Shia triggers ##Lux Mark#1015#, increases Night Rabbit's &Param2&.

description.zh: 希娅冲浪造成伤害时，眩晕目标。提升冲浪的&Param3&。
description.en: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, stuns the target.Increases &Param3& of her rides.

description.zh: 援护技持续期间，希娅的&Param3&随时间提升。
description.en: While the Support Skill is active, increases Shia's &Param3& over time.

description.zh: 希娅每次消灭目标，提升自身&Param4&。
description.en: Every time Shia kills a target, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 希娅每次触发##光系印记#1015#时，提升自身&Param4&。
description.en: Every time Shia triggers ##Lux Mark#1015#, increases her &Param4&.

description.zh: 希娅冲浪造成伤害时，提升目标受到冲浪的伤害。
description.en: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, increases the surfing DMG taken by the target.

description.zh: 提升光系角色&Param2&。
description.en: Increases Lux Trekkers' &Param2&.

description.zh: 提升企鹅玩偶的大小和移速。企鹅玩偶造成伤害时，提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the penguin plushie's size and Movement SPD. When the penguin plushie deals DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 企鹅玩偶造成多段伤害，同时恢复主控角色生命。
description.en: The penguin plushie deals multiple instances of DMG and restores the main Trekker's HP.

description.zh: 小禾普攻时，有概率发射更多弩箭。主控技冷却期间，概率更高。
description.en: Nazuna's Auto Attacks have a chance to fire additional crossbow bolts. The chance is higher while the Main Skill is on cooldown.

description.zh: 小禾普攻换弹时发动旋转射击，发射多发跟踪弩箭，同时提升全队的&Param2&。
description.en: When Nazuna reloads during an Auto Attack, she delivers a spinning shot, firing multiple tracking crossbow bolts. Also increases the squad's &Param2&.

description.zh: 企鹅玩偶移动结束时扑向目标。提升企鹅玩偶造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When the penguin plushie stops, it pounces on the target. Also increases the penguin plushie's &Param2&.

description.zh: 企鹅玩偶在场时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: While the penguin plushie is on the battlefield, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 小禾装填弹匣时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: When Nazuna reloads, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 小禾普攻时，有概率抛出金蛋造成范围伤害。
description.en: When Nazuna performs an Auto Attack, there is a chance to throw a golden egg, dealing AoE DMG.

description.zh: 小禾装填弹匣时，提升援护角色&Param1&。
description.en: When Nazuna reloads, increases Support Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升小禾闪避次数。闪避时提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: Nazuna can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 小禾施放主控技时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: When Nazuna casts the Main Skill, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 小禾主控技冷却期间，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: While Nazuna's Main Skill is on cooldown, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升全队地系角色的印记伤害倍率。
description.en: Increases all Terra Trekkers' Mark DMG Multiplier.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招旋转期间，可牵引周围目标。提升小禾绝招伤害。
description.en: While Nazuna spins during the Ultimate, she pulls in nearby targets. Also increases her Ultimate DMG.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，有概率提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, there is a chance to increase the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 增强「鹅之吻」效果。增加企鹅雕像攻击次数。
description.en: Enhances Kiss of Penguin. The penguin statue now launches more attacks.

description.zh: 抽奖结果中，企鹅出现概率大幅提升。提升企鹅雕像攻击范围，造成伤害时使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: The chance to draw penguins in raffles is greatly increased. When the penguin statue deals DMG, increases the target's &Param1&. Also increases the penguin statue's Attack Range.

description.zh: 抽奖结果中，爱心出现概率大幅提升。爱心箭矢可弹射。
description.en: The chance to draw hearts in raffles is greatly increased. The heart arrow can ricochet.

description.zh: 增强「爱之吻」效果。爱心箭矢可引发二次爆炸。
description.en: Enhances Kiss of Heart. The heart arrow now triggers a second explosion.

description.zh: 扫射时，如果本次抽奖企鹅数量大于爱心，额外造成范围伤害。
description.en: When unleashing a barrage, if more penguins than hearts are drawn in this baffle, Nazuna deals additional AoE DMG.

description.zh: 抽奖产生企鹅雕像后，小禾施放扫射，同时提升主控角色&Param1&。
description.en: After the penguin statue from the raffle appears, Nazuna unleashes a barrage and the main Trekker's &Param1& is increased.

description.zh: 企鹅雕像消失时自爆。
description.en: Upon vanishing, the penguin statue explodes.

description.zh: 扫射时，如果本次抽奖爱心数量大于企鹅，则本次扫射发射的弩箭可穿透目标，造成伤害时，提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: When unleashing a barrage, if more hearts than penguins are drawn in this baffle, the crossbow bolts will pierce through targets. When dealing DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升扫射和爱心箭矢造成的&Param2&，以及爱心箭矢恢复的生命。
description.en: Increases the barrage and heart arrow's &Param2&. The heart arrow now restores more HP.

description.zh: 小禾在场时，提升全队地系角色&Param1&。
description.en: When Nazuna is on the battlefield, increases all Terra Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 抽奖时，提升小禾&Param1&。
description.en: During raffles, increases Nazuna's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放爱心箭矢后，小禾施放扫射，同时提升主控角色&Param1&。
description.en: After firing the heart arrow, Nazuna unleashes a barrage and increases the main Trekker's &Param1&.

description.zh: 抽奖结果连续全为企鹅或爱心时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: If the last 2 raffles are full penguins or full hearts, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「鲨老大」发动攻击可引来鱼群涡流造成范围伤害。提升花铃对附带##暗灼#2028#的目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Boss Shark's attacks summon a vortex of fish, dealing AoE DMG. Increases Karin's &Param2& against targets inflicted with ##Dark Burn#2028#.

description.zh:
花铃施放主控技后引来「鲨老大」跟随，期间每隔一定时间对主控目标发动飞扑攻击造成范围伤害。提升
花铃的&Param2&。
description.en:
After casting the Main Skill, Karin summons Boss Shark to follow her. During this time, Boss Shark periodically lunges at the Main Trekker's target, dealing AoE DMG.
Increases Karin's &Param2&.

description.zh: 花铃对附带##猎标#4046#的目标普攻时可发动吊射。花铃对目标附加##猎标#4046#时，一定时间内可发射更多普攻子弹。提升花铃的&Param2&和&Param4&。
description.en: When Karin hits a target inflicted with ##Hunter's Mark#4046# with Auto Attacks, she can fire lob shots. When Karin inflicts ##Hunter's Mark#4046# on a target, she can fire more Auto Attack bullets for a certain duration. Increases Karin's &Param2& and &Param4&.

description.zh: 延长##猎标#4046#的持续时间。花铃和附带##猎标#4046#的目标连线期间，对路径上的目标持续造成伤害，并回复花铃的##狩能#4045#点数。花铃对目标附加##猎标#4046#时，提升自身的&Param3&和&Param5&。
description.en: Extends the duration of ##Hunter's Mark#4046#. While Karin is linked to a target with ##Hunter's Mark#4046#, she deals DMG over time to all targets along the link path and restores ##Hunting Energy#4045#. When Karin inflicts ##Hunter's Mark#4046# on a target, increases her &Param3& and &Param5&.

description.zh: 花铃造成多次绝招伤害时，引来「鲨老大」的尾击造成范围伤害。
description.en: After Karin deals Ultimate DMG several times, Boss Shark follows up with a tail strike that deals AoE DMG.

description.zh: 「鲨老大」造成伤害时，提升花铃的&Param1&，暗系均衡角色的&Param3&。
description.en: When Boss Shark deals DMG, increases Karin's &Param1& and the &Param3& of Umbra Versatile Trekkers.

description.zh: 全队都为暗系角色时，提升「鲨老大」对附带##暗灼#2028#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: In an all-Umbra squad, increases the &Param1& dealt by Boss Shark to targets inflicted with ##Dark Burn#2028#.

description.zh: 敌方目标失去##猎标#4046#时，造成范围伤害。
description.en: When an enemy target loses ##Hunter's Mark#4046#, deals AoE DMG.

description.zh: 全队都为暗系角色时，在主控技「愿者上钩」冷却期间，提升花铃的普攻对附带##暗灼#2028#的目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: In an all-Umbra squad, when Bait and Catch (Main Skill) is on cooldown, increases the &Param1& dealt by Karin's Auto Attacks to targets inflicted with ##Dark Burn#2028#.

description.zh: 花铃触发##暗系印记#1019#时，提升&Param1&。
description.en: When Karin triggers an ##Umbra Mark#1019#, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中的暗系角色可提升花铃的&Param1&，全队暗系角色的&Param3&。
description.en: Umbra Trekkers in the squad increase Karin's &Param1& and all Umbra Trekkers' &Param3&.

description.zh: 花铃对附带##猎标#4046#的目标触发##暗系印记#1019#时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: When Karin triggers ##Umbra Mark#1019# on a target with ##Hunter's Mark#4046#, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 增加闪避技能次数。闪避时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: Can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升绝招「狂鲨强袭」对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&。提升花铃的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by Shark Assault (Ultimate) to elite or higher-tier targets. Increases Karin's &Param3&.

description.zh: 绝招「狂鲨强袭」期间可持续喷出水泡，造成范围伤害。提升花铃的&Param3&。
description.en: While Shark Assault (Ultimate) is active, continuously shoots bubbles to deal AoE DMG. Increases Karin's &Param3&.

description.zh: 施放绝招「狂鲨强袭」时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting Shark Assault (Ultimate), increases Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」的「鲨老大」可连续撕咬造成<color=#0abec5>多次伤害</color>。
description.en: Boss Shark summoned by Raging Sea (Support Skill) can repeatedly bite the target, dealing <color=#0abec5>multiple instances of DMG</color>.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」的「鲨老大」造成伤害时产生齿痕，后续「鲨老大」的伤害可引爆齿痕造成单体伤害。
description.en: Boss Shark summoned by Raging Sea (Support Skill) leaves bite marks when dealing DMG. Subsequent DMG from Boss Shark can detonate these bite marks, dealing single-target DMG.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」可额外挥舞更多锁链造成更多伤害。
description.en: When casting Raging Sea (Support Skill), Karin can swing additional chains to deal more DMG.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」挥舞锁链造成伤害时，可产生爆炸造成范围伤害。
description.en: When Karin swings the chain to deal DMG during Raging Sea (Support Skill), triggers explosions that deal AoE DMG.

description.zh:
援护技「怒海翻腾」的「鲨老大」冲锋路径上会引发水泡爆炸造成范围伤害。提升
「鲨老大」造成的&Param2&。
description.en:
Boss Shark summoned by Raging Sea (Support Skill) triggers bubble explosions along its charge path, dealing AoE DMG.
Increases the &Param2& dealt by Boss Shark.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」的「鲨老大」造成伤害时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: When Boss Shark summoned by Raging Sea (Support Skill) deals DMG, increases Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技「怒海翻腾」的「鲨老大」对精英及以下目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by Boss Shark summoned by Raging Sea (Support Skill) to elite or lower-tier targets.

description.zh: 援护技「怒海翻腾」挥舞锁链造成伤害时，提升本次技能后续锁链造成的&Param1&。
description.en: When Karin swings the chain to deal DMG during Raging Sea (Support Skill), increases the &Param1& dealt by subsequent chain hits of this skill.

description.zh: 任意暗系角色施放主控技或援护技时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: When any Umbra Trekker casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升全队暗系角色的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases all Umbra Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放援护技「怒海翻腾」时，提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: When casting Raging Sea (Support Skill), increases Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: 提升援护技「怒海翻腾」挥舞锁链对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& dealt by chain swings during Raging Sea (Support Skill) to elite or higher-tier targets.

description.zh: 队伍中的暗系角色可提升花铃的&Param1&。
description.en: Umbra Trekkers in the squad increase Karin's &Param1&.

description.zh: ##「胡桃上校」#4020#和##「卷毛大将」#4021#的协同技能加强。##「发条女王」#4022#的射击加强。
description.en: Enhances the Synergy Skills of ##Colonel Walnut#4020# and ##General Curly#4021#.Enhances ##Clockwork Queen#4022#'s shots.

description.zh: 施放主控技「&Param1&」或「&Param2&」时，召唤玩具##「发条女王」#4022#，并为##「胡桃上校」#4020#或##「卷毛大将」#4021#增加「士气」。
description.en: Casting &Param1& or &Param2& (Main Skill) summons ##Clockwork Queen#4022# and boosts Morale for ##Colonel Walnut#4020# and ##General Curly#4021#.

description.zh: 主控技「&Param1&」强化为多段打击。
description.en: &Param1& (Main Skill) becomes a multi-hit attack.

description.zh: 「胡桃上校」和「卷毛大将」造成伤害时附加「礼盒」标记。圣夜菈露的技能对附带「礼盒」标记的目标造成伤害时产生额外范围伤害。
description.en: When Colonel Walnut and General Curly deal DMG, they inflict the Gift Box mark.Snowish Laru's skills deal additional AoE DMG against marked targets.

description.zh: ##「胡桃上校」#4020#和##「卷毛大将」#4021#对附带##火焰印记#1016#的目标造成伤害时，有概率获得「士气」，并提升自身&Param2&。
description.en: When ##Colonel Walnut#4020# and ##General Curly#4021# deal DMG to targets with ##Ignis Mark#1016#, they have a chance to gain Morale and increase their &Param2&.

description.zh: ##「卷毛大将」#4021#每秒对自身附近的目标造成伤害。
description.en: ##General Curly#4021# deals DMG to nearby targets every second.

description.zh: 每个在场的玩具，提升所有圣夜菈露仆从的&Param1&。
description.en: Each toy present increases the &Param1& of all Snowish Laru's minions.

description.zh: 主控技「&Param1&」或「&Param2&」暴击时，提升圣夜菈露&Param3&。
description.en: When &Param1& or &Param2& (Main Skill) lands a Crit Hit, increases Snowish Laru's &Param3&.

description.zh: 主控技「&Param1&」的攻击范围扩大。提升「&Param1&」和「&Param2&」造成的&Param3&。
description.en: Increases the Attack Range of &Param1& (Main Skill).Increases the &Param3& of &Param1& and &Param2&.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露造成伤害时，召唤一个雪橇炮台向目标射击。雪橇炮台暴击时，提升圣夜菈露和在场玩具的&Param5&。
description.en: When Snowish Laru deals DMG, she summons a Sled Turret to attack the target.When the Sled Turret lands a Crit Hit, increases the &Param5& of Snowish Laru and all toys on the battlefield.

description.zh: 提升圣夜菈露闪避次数和&Param2&。每间隔一段时间，圣夜菈露受到直接伤害时，免疫本次伤害。
description.en: Snowish Laru can dodge one more time. Also, increases her &Param2&.Periodically, Snowish Laru becomes immune to direct DMG taken once.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露的普攻暴击时，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: When Snowish Laru's Auto Attack lands a Crit Hit, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露变身「菈露爵士」期间，枪械射击和技能「&Param1&」可触发##火焰印记#1016#，产生「灼炎」。提升圣夜菈露的&Param3&。
description.en: While transformed into Dame Laru, Snowish Laru's shots and &Param1& can trigger ##Ignis Mark#1016# and inflict Conflagration.Increases Snowish Laru's &Param3&.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露变身为「菈露爵士」期间，施放技能「&Param1&」时，提升自身&Param2&。
description.en: While transformed into Dame Laru, casting &Param1& increases her &Param2&.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露变身为「菈露爵士」期间，技能「&Param1&」造成伤害时，提升自身&Param2&。
description.en: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases her &Param2& each time &Param1& deals DMG.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露变身为「菈露爵士」期间，队伍中火系角色的&Param1&随时间提升。
description.en: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases the &Param1& of Ignis Trekkers in the squad over time.

description.zh: 「礼盒炮弹」爆炸后，持续对范围内的目标造成伤害。
description.en: After a Gift Box Shell explodes, it deals DMG to targets within range over time.

description.zh: 提升「礼盒炮弹」造成的技能伤害与伤害范围。当全队角色为火系，「礼盒炮弹」对目标造成伤害时，提升目标受到技能伤害。
description.en: Increases the Skill DMG and Attack Range of Gift Box Shells.If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, when Gift Box Shells deal DMG to the target, increases the Skill DMG Taken of the target.

description.zh: 使##「胡桃上校」#4023#合体成##「卷毛大将」#4024#。当全队角色为火系，##「卷毛大将」#4024#的&Param3&随时间提升。
description.en: Combines ##Colonel Walnuts#4023# into ##General Curly#4024#.If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, increases ##General Curly#4024#'s &Param3& over time.

description.zh: ##「胡桃上校」#4023#和##「卷毛大将」#4024#学会技能，自动施放攻击目标。「卷毛大将」的技能会提升自身&Param5&。
description.en: ##Colonel Walnut#4023# and ##General Curly#4024# learn skills, which they automatically cast to attack targets.General Curly's skill also increases its &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升援护技「&Param1&」造成的&Param2&与射击次数。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& and number of shots of &Param1& (Support Skill).

description.zh: 「礼盒炮弹」造成伤害时，提升圣夜菈露的&Param1&。
description.en: When a Gift Box Shell deals DMG, increases the &Param1& of Snowish Laru.

description.zh: 提升「礼盒炮弹」对附带##火焰印记#1016#的目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: Increases the &Param2& dealt by Gift Box Shells to targets with ##Ignis Mark#1016#.

description.zh: ##「胡桃上校」#4023#和##「卷毛大将」#4024#对附近的目标持续造成仆从伤害。
description.en: ##Colonel Walnut#4023# and ##General Curly#4024# deal Minion DMG to nearby targets over time.

description.zh: 提升##「胡桃上校」#4023#和##「卷毛大将」#4024#的&Param1&，每次造成伤害时，提升自身&Param3&，每次暴击时提升队伍中火系角色的&Param7&。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of ##Colonel Walnut#4023# and ##General Curly#4024#. Each time they deal DMG, increases their &Param3&; each time they land a Crit Hit, increases the &Param7& of Ignis Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 圣夜菈露每次上场时，提升火系主控角色的&Param1&。
description.en: Each time Snowish Laru enters combat, increases the main Ignis Trekker's &Param1&.

description.zh: 变身为「菈露爵士」期间，提升自身&Param1&，且枪械射击和技能可附加##火系印记：圣焰#2013#。
description.en: While Snowish Laru transforms into Dame Laru, increases her &Param1&. Her shots and skill can inflict ##Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame#2013#.

description.zh: 提升##「胡桃上校」#4023#和##「卷毛大将」#4024#的作战时间和&Param1&。
description.en: Increases the combat duration and &Param1& of ##Colonel Walnut#4023# and ##General Curly#4024#.

description.zh: 当队伍中所有角色均为火系，「礼盒炮弹」造成伤害时提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: When the squad contains only Ignis Trekkers, Gift Box Shell increases the target's &Param1& upon dealing DMG to the target.

description.zh: 「瑞兆」光线的伤害间隔缩短，且每多1个「瑞兆」，其光线伤害间隔额外缩短。
description.en: Reduces Auspice Beam's Attack Interval. Each additional Auspice shortens the Attack Interval.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。施放主控技时，额外生成「瑞兆」，每个「瑞兆」之间也会形成光线，持续造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Springseek Coronis. Casting Main Skill generates additional Auspice. Beams link all Auspice units, dealing DMG over time, and can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 弹匣容量提升。「结晶状态」期间，射速提升，发射结晶子弹，命中目标时额外造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。
description.en: Increases Ammo Capacity. When in Crystallized State, increases Fire Rate and fires crystalline bullets that deal additional DMG on hit. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#.

description.zh: 结晶状态下，持续生成「玫瑰脉冲」：命中时目标处生成结晶地面，延迟造成伤害，可触发##地系印记#1020#。如果结晶地面受到新春科洛妮丝普攻伤害时，会提前引爆，伤害提升。
description.en: When in Crystallized State, continuously generates Rose Pulses: Hitting a target creates Crystalline Ground at the target's location to deal delayed DMG. Can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#. When Crystallized Ground receives Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG, it detonates early and deals increased DMG.

description.zh: 「瑞兆」造成的&Param1&提升，且根据场上生成的「瑞兆」数量，伤害额外提升。
description.en: Increases Auspice's &Param1&. Increases DMG additionally based on the number of Auspice on the battlefield.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝造成普攻伤害时，使「瑞兆」造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases Auspice's &Param1&.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升，普攻的子弹经过「瑞兆」附近或光线时，可延长所有「瑞兆」存在时间。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Springseek Coronis. When Auto Attack bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, the duration of all active Auspice is extended.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升，对远处的目标，&Param3&额外提升。
description.en: Increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&. Increases &Param3& additionally against distant targets.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝造成普攻伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招可以触发##地系印记#1020#。触发印记时，&Param1&提升。
description.en: Ultimate can trigger ##Terra Mark#1020#. Increases &Param1& on trigger.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。普攻的子弹经过「瑞兆」附近或光线时，变为可穿透，且造成的&Param3&提升
description.en: Increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&. When Auto Attack bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, they gain Penetration and increased &Param3&.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。「结晶状态」期间，自身触发##地系印记#1020#时，延长该状态时间。
description.en: Increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&. When in Crystallized State, triggering ##Terra Mark#1020# extends the state's duration.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝闪避次数提升。闪避后自身&Param1&提升。
description.en: Springseek Coronis can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招对精英及以上目标造成的&Param1&提升，同时使普通目标受到##魅惑#4502#：持续时间结束时造成伤害。
description.en: Increases Ultimate's &Param1& against elite or higher-tier targets. Additionally inflicts ##Charm#4502# on normal targets, dealing DMG when the effect ends.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。绝招处于冷却或绝招能量未满时，队伍中地系先锋和均衡角色&Param3&提升。
description.en: Increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the &Param3& of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers in the squad.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&.

description.zh: 施放援护技「落地开花」后的短时间内，「玫瑰药剂」造成的&Param2&提升。「玫瑰药剂」结束时，会再次造成伤害。
description.en: For a short duration after casting Instant Blossom (Support Skill), increases Rose Vials' &Param2&.When a Rose Vial expires, it deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 队伍中每存在一个地系角色，「玫瑰药剂」造成的&Param1&提升。「玫瑰药剂」会极速绽放，一次性结算持续期间内的伤害。
description.en: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the &Param1& of Rose Vial.Rose Vial will undergo a Rapid Bloom, instantly triggering all remaining DMG from its duration.

description.zh: 队伍中每存在一个地系角色，「枯萎药剂」造成的&Param1&提升。援护技抛射「枯萎药剂」和「玫瑰药剂」的数量发生变化，并且「枯萎药剂」会使相邻的「玫瑰药剂」也变为「枯萎药剂」。
description.en: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the &Param1& of Wither Vial.Changes the number of Rose Vials and Wither Vials thrown by the Support Skill. The Wither Vial converts adjacent Rose Vials into Wither Vials as well.

description.zh: 所有药剂的持续时间延长。
description.en: Extends the duration of all Vials.

description.zh: 场上每存在1瓶「玫瑰药剂」，「玫瑰药剂」造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: For each Rose Vial on the field, increases Rose Vials' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「玫瑰药剂」附加##地系印记：地脉#2029#时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Rose Vial inflicts ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#, increases the &Param1& of the target.

description.zh: 「玫瑰药剂」对目标附加##地系印记：地脉#2029#后的一段时间内，该目标被触发##地系印记#1020#时，额外对其造成伤害。
description.en: For a short duration after Rose Vial inflicts ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029# on the target, triggering ##Terra Mark#1020# on the target deals additional DMG.

description.zh: 场上每存在1瓶「枯萎药剂」，「枯萎药剂」造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: For each Wither Vial on the field, increases Wither Vials' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「枯萎药剂」附加非满层的「枯萎效果」时，造成伤害。当前每有1层「枯萎效果」，使附加「枯萎效果」时造成的&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Wither Vial applies Wither stack to a target that has not yet reached the max stack limit, it deals DMG. For every current stack of Wither on the target, the &Param1& upon applying a new stack is increased.

description.zh: 新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。
description.en: Increases the &Param1& of Springseek Coronis.

description.zh: 绝招可以附加##地系印记：地脉#2029#，新春科洛妮丝&Param1&提升。
description.en: Ultimate can inflict ##Terra Mark: Earth Vein#2029#. Increases Springseek Coronis's &Param1&.

description.zh: 场上有「玫瑰药剂」或「枯萎药剂」时，全队地系角色&Param1&提升。
description.en: When a Rose Vial or Wither Vial is on the field, increases all Terra Trekkers' &Param1&.

description.zh: 如果队友均为地系角色，新春科洛妮丝造成技能伤害时，场上每个「玫瑰药剂」使目标受到地系印记伤害提升。
description.en: When all squadmates are Terra Trekkers, each Rose Vial on the field increases the Terra Mark DMG taken by the target when Springseek Coronis deals Skill DMG.

description.zh: 「泡泡机」模式下，附带##「泡沫标记」#4041#目标生成可吸收泡泡，「泡泡蛙」吸收后体型变大并提升其造成的&Param1&。
description.en: In Bubble Machine mode, targets with ##Bubble Mark#4041# generate absorbable bubbles. After absorbing them, Bubble Frog grows in size, and the &Param1& it deals increases.

description.zh: 「泡泡机」模式下，「泡泡蛙」对周围目标持续造成水系技能伤害，同时使目标&Param2&提升，可附加##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: In Bubble Machine mode, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG to nearby targets over time while increasing their &Param2& and inflicting ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 「扩音器」模式下，提升「泡泡蛙」弹跳频率和造成的&Param1&。「泡泡蛙」每次弹跳，额外增加分贝值。
description.en: In Megaphone mode, increases Bubble Frog's bounce frequency and &Param1&. Each bounce grants additional Decibels.

description.zh: 「扩音器」模式下，「泡泡蛙」弹跳时，产生可传播多次的##回响声波#4047#，造成水系技能伤害，同时使目标受到所有系伤害提升，该伤害可附加##水系印记：水流#2008#。根据当前分贝值，提升##回响声波#4047#的伤害范围。
description.en: In Megaphone mode, Bubble Frog unleashes ##Echoing Soundwave#4047# when bouncing, which can echo multiple times, dealing Aqua Skill DMG and increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements. This DMG can inflict ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.The Attack Range of ##Echoing Soundwave#4047# increases based on the current Decibels.

description.zh: 薇洛和「泡泡蛙」对##「泡沫标记」#4041#目标造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When Willow and Bubble Frog deal DMG to targets with ##Bubble Mark#4041#, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 队友对附带##「泡沫标记」#4041#的目标触发##水系印记#1018#或附加##水系印记：水流#2008#时，提升全队水系角色&Param1&。
description.en: When a squadmate triggers ##Aqua Mark#1018# or inflicts ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008# on targets with ##Bubble Mark#4041#,  increases all Aqua Trekkers' &Param1& in the squad.

description.zh: 「泡泡机」模式下，泡泡额外造成范围水系技能伤害，可附加##水系印记：水流#2008#。提升全队水系角色对##「泡沫标记」#4041#目标造成的&Param2&。
description.en: In Bubble Machine mode, bubbles deal additional AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Can inflict ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.Increases the &Param2& dealt by all Aqua Trekkers against targets with ##Bubble Mark#4041#.

description.zh: ##回响声波#4047#造成伤害时，提升自身和非水系队友&Param1&。
description.en: When ##Echoing Soundwave#4047# deal DMG, increases own and non-Aqua Squadmates' &Param1&.

description.zh: 「泡泡蛙」每次弹跳时，提升全队&Param1&，额外提升非水系队友&Param5&。
description.en: Each time Bubble Frog bounces, increases the squad's &Param1&. Additionally, increases non-Aqua Squadmates' &Param5&.

description.zh: 提升闪避次数。薇洛闪避后，提升自身&Param1&。
description.en: Can dodge one more time. After Willow dodges, increases own &Param1&.

description.zh: 「泡泡蛙」持续时间延长，存在时提升全队角色&Param1&。
description.en: Increases Bubble Frog duration, and while it is on the field, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 「泡泡蛙」每弹跳一定次数后，造成大范围水系技能伤害，可附加##水系印记：水流#2008#，同时使目标受到所有系伤害提升。
description.en: After bouncing a certain number of times, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG in a large area. Can inflict ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#, while increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements.

description.zh: 「泡泡蛙」造成伤害时，薇洛获得护盾。
description.en: When Bubble Frog deals DMG, Willow gains a shield.

description.zh: &Param1&提升。施放绝招后，一段时间内额外获得分贝值。
description.en: Increases &Param1&. After casting the Ultimate, generates additional Decibels for a period of time.

description.zh: 施放绝招时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 绝招造成伤害时，使目标&Param1&提升。
description.en: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: ##「柔声劝导」#4042#可获得##「安全警告」#4043#额外的属性增益。薇洛每发动<color=#0abec5>10</color>次射击，并且当前处于「柔声劝导」状态时，会发射水柱直线攻击，造成水系技能伤害，提升分贝值，同时附加##「微笑制裁」#4040#和##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: ##Gentle Warning#4042# gains additional stat bonuses from ##Safety Alert#4043#. For every <color=#0abec5>10</color> shots fired by Willow while under Gentle Warning, she fires a straight-line water column attack that deals Aqua Skill DMG and increases Decibels, while applying ##Smiling Sanction#4040# and ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 当前分贝值≥40时，立即消耗分贝值，发射旋转水柱，造成大范围水系技能伤害，同时附加##「微笑制裁」#4040#和##水系印记：水流#2008#。
description.en: When Decibels ≥40, consumes Decibels to fire a rotating water jet, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting ##Smiling Sanction#4040# and ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008#.

description.zh: 援护技入场时的初始分贝值提升。分贝值满时，提升全队&Param1&，同时持续消耗分贝值高速发射泡泡。
description.en: Increases initial Decibels upon entering the field. At full Decibels, increases the squad's &Param1&, while continuously consuming Decibels to rapidly fire bubbles.

description.zh: 提升射击获得的分贝值。##「安全警告」#4043#状态下泡泡变为音浪，伤害倍率提升，同时使目标&Param2&提升。
description.en: Increases Decibels gained from shots.While ##Safety Alert#4043# is active, bubbles turn into sonic waves, increasing DMG multiplier and the target's &Param2&.

description.zh: 援护技入场时，跳入水中的伤害也会附加1层##「微笑制裁」#4040#。提升##「微笑制裁」#4040#层数上限，并额外提升目标&Param1&。
description.en: When entering with the Support Skill, the DMG from diving into the water also inflicts 1 stack of ##Smiling Sanction#4040#. Increases the max stack limit of ##Smiling Sanction#4040#, and additionally increases the target's &Param1&.

description.zh: 附带##「微笑制裁」#4040#的目标触发##水系印记#1018#时，立即再次附加一次##水系印记：水流#2008#，额外造成水系印记伤害并根据##「微笑制裁」#4040#层数提升此次造成的&Param2&。
description.en: When a target with ##Smiling Sanction#4040# has ##Aqua Mark#1018# triggered, this target is immediately inflicted with ##Aqua Mark: Torrent#2008# again and receives additional Aqua Mark DMG. The &Param2& received this time is increased based on the stacks of ##Smiling Sanction#4040#.

description.zh: ##「柔声劝导」#4042#状态下，额外提升全队&Param1&，且主控角色造成伤害时，额外提供分贝值。
description.en: While ##Gentle Warning#4042# is active, additionally increases the squad's &Param1&, and the Main Trekker generates extra Decibels when dealing DMG.

description.zh: 「泡泡浴场」面积持续增加。主控角色处于「泡泡浴场」内时，提升该角色&Param1&。
description.en: Bubble Bath expands over time. When the Main Trekker is inside Bubble Bath, increases her &Param1&.

description.zh: 薇洛每发动一定次数的射击，处于「泡泡浴场」内的目标附近生成1个蓝色水泡，造成范围水系技能伤害，同时提升全队&Param2&。产生蓝色水泡时，有概率变成红色水泡，主控角色额外提升&Param6&。
description.en: For every certain number of shots fired by Willow, a blue bubble is generated near targets inside Bubble Bath, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG, while increasing the squad's &Param2&. When a blue bubble is generated, there is a chance it turns into a red bubble, additionally increasing Main Trekker's &Param6&.

description.zh: 处于「泡泡浴场」内一段时间后，主控角色获得护盾。
description.en: After staying in Bubble Bath for a period of time, the Main Trekker gains a shield.

description.zh: 薇洛在场时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: When Willow is on the battlefield, increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 消耗分贝值时，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: Consuming Decibels increases the squad's &Param1&.

description.zh: 队伍中每有一个水系角色，提升全队&Param1&。
description.en: Each Aqua Trekker in the squad increases the squad's &Param1&.
